attributes.description: Indicates whether the downtime event was planned (scheduled maintenance, changeover, tooling change per production schedule) or unplanned (unexpected breakdown, quality hold, material shortage). Critical for separating planned vs. unplanned OEE availability losses.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 – Planned vs. Unplanned Downtime; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed duration of the downtime event in minutes, calculated as the difference between end_timestamp and start_timestamp. Stored as a business field for direct use in OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) availability calculations and SCADA-integrated downtime reporting. Null if the event has not yet ended.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 – Downtime Duration; IATF 16949 Section 9.1; SAP PM – Breakdown Duration

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the downtime event ended and production resumed, as recorded by the MES or SCADA system. Null if the event is still active. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Downtime End; SCADA Event Log; ISO 22400-2

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Indicates the management escalation level reached during the downtime event based on duration thresholds or safety/quality triggers. 'none' = resolved at operator level; 'supervisor' = shift supervisor notified; 'manager' = production manager engaged; 'plant_director' = plant director escalation triggered. Supports escalation SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 5.3 – Organizational Roles; SAP PM – Notification Priority; Internal Escalation Matrix

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the downtime event started. Derived from start_timestamp for day-level partitioning, reporting, and trend analysis. Stored as a separate DATE field to support efficient date-range queries and daily OEE dashboard aggregations. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 – Downtime Reporting; SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Date

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the downtime event as entered by the operator, technician, or supervisor in the MES or SAP PM notification. Captures contextual details not covered by structured codes, such as observed symptoms, environmental conditions, or operator observations at the time of failure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Notification Long Text; Apriso MES – Event Notes; IATF 16949 Section 10.2

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the downtime event, typically generated by the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) or SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) module. Format: DT-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Used for cross-system referencing and shop floor communication.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Downtime Event Reference; SAP PM Notification Number

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the downtime event record. 'open' indicates the event is active and unresolved; 'in_progress' indicates a repair or corrective action is underway; 'resolved' indicates the root cause has been addressed; 'closed' indicates the event is fully documented and closed; 'cancelled' indicates the event was logged in error.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Notification Status; Apriso MES – Downtime Status; IATF 16949 Section 10.2

attributes.name: failure_mode_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific failure mode that caused the downtime event, aligned with the FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) failure mode library. Examples: electrical fault, hydraulic leak, sensor failure, conveyor jam. Enables FMEA-driven root cause trending and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) corrective action tracking.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 10.2 – FMEA; SAP PM – Damage Code; AIAG FMEA Reference Manual

attributes.name: fault_location_code
attributes.description: SAP PM object part / location code identifying the specific component or sub-assembly on the equipment where the fault occurred (e.g., spindle, conveyor belt, welding gun tip, paint nozzle). Enables component-level failure frequency analysis and spare parts demand forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Object Part Code; ISO 14224 – Equipment Taxonomy; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: is_quality_hold_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the downtime event triggered a quality hold on WIP (Work in Progress) or finished vehicle inventory. True = quality hold was activated; False = no quality hold. Links to SAP QM quality notification and SPC (Statistical Process Control) out-of-control action plans.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM – Quality Notification; IATF 16949 Section 8.6; SPC AIAG Reference Manual

attributes.name: is_repeat_failure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this downtime event is a recurrence of a previously recorded failure on the same equipment or work center within a defined lookback period (typically 30 days). True = repeat failure; False = first occurrence. Used to identify chronic equipment issues requiring escalated corrective action under IATF 16949 Section 10.2.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 10.2 – Nonconformity and Corrective Action; SAP PM – Recurring Breakdown

attributes.name: is_safety_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the downtime event involved a safety incident, near-miss, or safety-critical equipment failure (e.g., AGV collision, robot safety stop, lockout/tagout activation). True = safety-related; False = non-safety. Triggers mandatory safety reporting and OSHA/DOT compliance escalation workflows.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 – Machine Safety; DOT FMVSS; IATF 16949 Section 8.4.2

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the downtime event record was most recently modified in the source system, such as when resolution notes were added, status was updated, or cost data was posted. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail in the Silver layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 7.5 – Documented Information; Databricks Lakehouse – Delta Lake Change Data Capture

attributes.name: maintenance_cost_local
attributes.description: Total direct maintenance cost incurred to resolve the downtime event, including labor, spare parts, and external service costs, expressed in the plant's local currency. Sourced from SAP PM actual cost settlement. Used for cost-of-downtime analysis and CapEx vs. OpEx maintenance budget reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Actual Cost; SAP CO – Cost Center Accounting; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) of the production program running on the affected line at the time of the downtime event. Used to correlate downtime patterns with specific model year launches, SOP (Start of Production) ramp-up periods, and EOP (End of Production) transitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Program; NHTSA MY Definition; Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Model Year

attributes.name: notification_number
attributes.description: The SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) notification number (Meldungsnummer) created in SAP S/4HANA to formally record the maintenance request or breakdown notification associated with this downtime event. Enables traceability between the MES downtime record and the SAP PM work order lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – PM Notification (IW21/IW22); IATF 16949 Section 7.1.3

attributes.name: oee_availability_loss_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of scheduled production time lost due to this downtime event, calculated as (duration_minutes / scheduled_production_time_minutes) × 100. Represents the availability loss component of the OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metric for the affected work center during the event period. Stored as a business field for direct use in OEE dashboards.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 – OEE Availability; IATF 16949 Section 9.1; SEMI E10 Standard

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: The powertrain type of the vehicle being produced at the time of the downtime event. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine, HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle, PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle, EV = Electric Vehicle, FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Used to analyze downtime patterns by powertrain technology, particularly relevant for EV/PHEV line ramp-up monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Material Classification; CAFE/EPA Powertrain Classification; UNECE Regulation

attributes.name: production_loss_units
attributes.description: Number of vehicle units or production units lost due to the downtime event, based on the planned production rate for the affected work center. Used to quantify the production order impact and schedule recovery requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 – Production Loss; SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Order Confirmation; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing the maintenance technician's description of the actions taken to resolve the downtime event and restore production. Complements corrective_action_code with detailed narrative. Stored in the Silver layer for use in AI/ML-based predictive maintenance model training.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Work Order Completion Text; IATF 16949 Section 10.2; AIAG 8D Step 5

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the confirmed root cause of the downtime event after investigation, aligned with the SAP PM cause code catalog. Distinct from failure_mode_code which captures the symptom; root_cause_code captures the underlying reason (e.g., inadequate lubrication, worn tooling, incorrect setup, supplier part defect).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Cause Code; IATF 16949 Section 10.2; AIAG 8D Problem Solving

attributes.name: scada_alarm_code
attributes.description: The alarm or fault code generated by the SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) or PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) system at the time the downtime event was triggered. Provides the raw machine-level signal that initiated the downtime record. Used for SCADA-integrated downtime reporting and automated event correlation.
attributes.references: IEC 62682 – Management of Alarm Systems; SCADA/PLC Event Log; Apriso MES – Machine Signal Integration

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which the downtime event was originated or captured. MES = Apriso/Dassault Manufacturing Execution System (automated); SAP_PM = SAP Plant Maintenance notification (manual or integrated); SCADA = SCADA system automated alarm; PLC = PLC-generated fault signal; MANUAL = manually entered by operator. Used for data lineage and source system reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PM; SCADA/PLC Integration; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: spare_parts_consumed
attributes.description: Indicates whether spare parts or materials were consumed from inventory to resolve the downtime event. True = spare parts were issued via SAP MM goods issue; False = no parts consumed (e.g., adjustment or reset only). Drives spare parts demand planning and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) replenishment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Goods Issue; SAP PM – Material Consumption; MRP APICS Standard

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the downtime event began, as recorded by the MES or SCADA system. This is the principal real-world event time used for duration calculation and shift-level reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Downtime Start; SCADA Event Log; ISO 22400-2

attributes.name: time_to_repair_minutes
attributes.description: Elapsed time in minutes from when the maintenance team began active repair work to when the equipment was restored to operational status. Distinct from duration_minutes (total downtime) and time_to_respond_minutes (response lag). Core component of MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) KPI calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 – MTTR; SAP PM – Repair Duration; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: time_to_respond_minutes
attributes.description: Elapsed time in minutes between the downtime event start_timestamp and the time the responsible maintenance or production team acknowledged and began responding to the event. Key metric for maintenance response SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance and MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) component analysis.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 9.1; SAP PM – Response Time; ISO 22400-2 – MTTR

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: The internal vehicle model or platform code (e.g., F-150, Silverado, Model 3 equivalent) being produced on the affected line at the time of the downtime event. Enables model-specific downtime analysis and supports PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) integration.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Vehicle Program Code; SAP S/4HANA PP – Material Master

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: The SAP PM maintenance work order number (Auftragsnummer) issued to address the downtime event. Distinct from the production order; this is the corrective or preventive maintenance order raised by the maintenance team in SAP PM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Maintenance Order (IW31/IW32); IATF 16949 Section 8.5

products.name: production_bom
products.description: Manufacturing Bill of Materials (BOM) record representing the production-level BOM used on the shop floor for a specific vehicle configuration and model year. Distinct from the engineering BOM (eBOM) in the engineering domain — this is the manufacturing BOM (mBOM) as released to production. Captures BOM header (vehicle model, MY, plant, effectivity dates), BOM status, and reference to the engineering change order that authorized it. Managed via SAP PP and Teamcenter PLM BOM transfer.
products.reference: SAP PP Manufacturing BOM (mBOM) / Teamcenter BOM Transfer

attributes.name: production_bom_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the manufacturing Bill of Materials (mBOM) record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP PP BOM Header (CS01/CS02); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: apqp_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.apqp_plan. Business justification: Production BOMs are released through APQP gates; ppap_status and apqp_phase on production_bom require traceability to the governing APQP plan. IATF 16949 APQP requires BOM-to-APQP-plan linkage for des

attributes.name: assembly_part_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.part_master. Business justification: The production BOM header references the top-level assembly part (finished vehicle or major subassembly) in part_master — standard SAP MBOM pattern. Required for cost rollup, PPAP submission, and engi

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Engineering Bill of Materials (eBOM) Reference ID
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this manufacturing BOM (mBOM) to the originating engineering BOM (eBOM) in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or PTC Windchill. Enables traceability from shop floor execution back to the engineering design intent. The eBOM-to-mBOM transformation is managed via the PLM-SAP integration.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Management; PTC Windchill EDM; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3

attributes.name: homologation_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.homologation_record. Business justification: Production BOMs must reflect homologation-approved component specifications for regulatory markets. Parts substitution or BOM changes require homologation validation. Real business process: homologati

attributes.name: inbound_part_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_part. Business justification: Production BOM must reference the approved inbound part to support supplier calloff generation, PPAP validation against BOM, and sourcing coverage checks during APQP. Manufacturing engineers and suppl

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: BOM Management Report requires each BOM to be tied to a vehicle model to ensure correct component list per model.

attributes.name: model_year_program_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vehicle Model Year Program Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vehicle_model_year_program. Business justification: Production BOMs are versioned and effectivity-dated by model year program. APQP phase gates and PPAP submissions are organized per model year program. This FK enables BOM effectivity management and PP

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: A manufacturing BOM is plant-specific — the same vehicle model may have different production BOMs at different plants due to local tooling, supplier sourcing, or process differences. The plant_code ST

attributes.name: powertrain_variant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.powertrain_variant. Business justification: Production BOMs are powertrain-variant-specific — EV, PHEV, and ICE variants require fundamentally different BOMs. PPAP and APQP processes require BOM validation against the certified powertrain_varia

attributes.name: primary_production_ebom_reference_bom_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Engineering Bill of Materials (eBOM) Reference ID
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this manufacturing BOM (mBOM) to the originating engineering BOM (eBOM) in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or PTC Windchill. Enables traceability from shop floor execution back to the engineering design intent. The eBOM-to-mBOM transformation is managed via the PLM-SAP integration.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Management; PTC Windchill EDM; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_line. Business justification: A production BOM is specific to a production line (e.g., a stamping line BOM differs from a final assembly BOM). The production_line_code STRING is a denormalized reference. Adding production_line_id

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.routing. Business justification: A production BOM is associated with a specific routing that defines the sequence of operations for manufacturing. The routing_number STRING is a denormalized reference. Adding routing_id FK normalizes

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sku_master. Business justification: Production BOMs define the finished assembly material number used for inventory valuation and MRP. material_number is a denormalized SKU reference. This FK is fundamental to SAP PP-MM integration for

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this manufacturing BOM received formal approval from the designated authority. Precedes the release_date in the BOM lifecycle workflow. Required for IATF 16949 documented information control.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; SAP PP Workflow; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the approving authority (e.g., Chief Engineer, Manufacturing Manager) who approved this BOM for production release. Distinct from released_by — approval may be a separate workflow step in Teamcenter PLM or SAP workflow.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3.3 – Design and Development Outputs; SAP PP Workflow; ISO 9001 Clause 8.3

attributes.name: apqp_phase
attributes.description: Current APQP phase associated with this BOM's program lifecycle. Phase 1=Plan and Define, Phase 2=Product Design and Development, Phase 3=Process Design and Development, Phase 4=Product and Process Validation, Phase 5=Launch/Feedback. Tracks BOM maturity relative to the program development gate.
attributes.references: AIAG APQP 2nd Edition; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3; SAP PP Program Management

attributes.name: assembly_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is assembled as a Completely Built Unit (CBU), Completely Knocked Down (CKD) kit for overseas assembly, or Semi Knocked Down (SKD) kit. Determines the BOM structure, component packaging, and applicable customs/import regulations for the target market.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Type; UNECE Vehicle Regulations; Customs Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: The base quantity of the header material for which the BOM component quantities are defined (e.g., 1 vehicle). All component quantities in the BOM are expressed relative to this base quantity. Corresponds to the SAP BOM header base quantity field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Header Base Quantity; ISO 9001 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the BOM base quantity (e.g., 'EA' for each/vehicle, 'PC' for piece, 'SET' for set). Corresponds to the SAP material master base unit of measure. Ensures consistent quantity calculations during MRP explosion and production order processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|L|M|M2|M3|SET — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: bom_alternative
attributes.description: SAP BOM alternative identifier (e.g., '01', '02') distinguishing multiple valid BOM configurations for the same material and plant. Supports variant BOMs for different production lines or regional configurations (e.g., LHD vs RHD, CKD vs SKD).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – BOM Alternative; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the manufacturing BOM, typically including the vehicle model, model year, plant, and key configuration attributes (e.g., '2025 F-150 XLT 3.5L EcoBoost AWD – Detroit Assembly Plant – MY2025 Production BOM'). Used for display in SAP, Teamcenter PLM, and reporting tools.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Header Description; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: bom_level
attributes.description: The maximum depth/level of the BOM hierarchy for this manufacturing BOM (e.g., 1 = single-level, 5 = five levels deep). Used to understand BOM complexity and to control multi-level BOM explosion in MRP and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Multi-Level BOM; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the manufacturing BOM. 'draft' indicates the BOM is under engineering review. 'released' means it has been authorized for production use. 'frozen' indicates no further changes are permitted (e.g., during active production run). 'superseded' means a newer BOM version has replaced it. 'obsolete' means the BOM is no longer valid.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – BOM Status; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM Management

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM by its intended use in the manufacturing process. 'production' is the standard mBOM used on the shop floor. 'phantom' represents sub-assemblies that are not stocked. 'sales' is used for variant configuration. 'spare_parts' is for after-sales service. 'co_product' is for by-products in manufacturing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – BOM Category; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_usage
attributes.description: SAP BOM usage indicator defining the organizational context in which the BOM is applied. 'production' (SAP usage 1) is the standard for shop floor manufacturing. 'engineering' (SAP usage 2) is for design/development. 'universal' (SAP usage 3) applies across all usages. Determines which BOM is selected during MRP and production order processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Usage (T415); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the manufacturing BOM (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3'). Incremented each time the BOM is revised through an approved Engineering Change Order. Enables version history tracking and rollback capability for quality investigations.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Versioning; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; SAP PP BOM Change History

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason for creating or modifying this BOM version (e.g., 'Cost reduction – substitute supplier for part X', 'Regulatory compliance – CARB Tier 3 emission update', 'Quality improvement – NVH fix per TSB-2024-001'). Required for IATF 16949 change control documentation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6 – Control of Changes; SAP PP Change Master; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.6

attributes.name: component_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct component line items (BOM positions) in this manufacturing BOM. Provides a quick indicator of BOM complexity and is used for completeness validation during BOM release. Does not include phantom sub-assembly components.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Item Count; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manufacturing BOM record was first created in the source system (SAP PP or Teamcenter PLM). Represents the business event of BOM creation, not the ETL load time. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data standards.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5; SAP PP BOM Header

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: The Engineering Change Order (ECO) number that authorized the creation or last modification of this manufacturing BOM. Provides full traceability from the shop floor BOM back to the formal engineering change management process in Teamcenter PLM. Required for IATF 16949 change control compliance.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Engineering Change Management; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; SAP PP ECO Integration

attributes.name: effectivity_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this manufacturing BOM version is no longer valid for production use. Corresponds to the SAP BOM 'Valid To' date. Null indicates the BOM is open-ended with no planned expiry. Used to manage BOM transitions during model year changeovers and End of Production (EOP).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Effectivity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: effectivity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this manufacturing BOM version becomes effective and valid for production use. Corresponds to the SAP BOM 'Valid From' date. Used for date-effective BOM explosion in MRP and production order creation. Aligns with Start of Production (SOP) planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Effectivity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; SAE J1739

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual End of Production (EOP) date for the vehicle program associated with this BOM. Marks the milestone when serial production of this vehicle configuration ceases. Used for last-time-buy planning, spare parts provisioning, and regulatory compliance archiving.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; SAP PP Production Planning; APQP

attributes.name: homologation_status
attributes.description: Status of the regulatory homologation (type approval) for the vehicle configuration defined by this BOM in the target regulatory market. 'approved' is required before vehicles built to this BOM can be legally sold in the target market. Managed through the Regulatory Compliance and Homologation process.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 567 – Certification; UNECE WP.29 Type Approval; Euro NCAP; DOT FMVSS

attributes.name: is_configurable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM uses SAP Variant Configuration (VC) to support multiple vehicle variants from a single configurable BOM structure. True = configurable BOM with characteristic-based component selection. False = fixed BOM for a single specific vehicle configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Variant Configuration (LO-VC); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: is_phantom_assembly
attributes.description: Indicates whether the header material of this BOM is a phantom assembly — a logical grouping of components that is not physically stocked or produced as a discrete unit. Phantom assemblies are 'exploded through' during MRP and production order processing. Common for sub-assemblies in JIS manufacturing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Phantom Assembly (Special Procurement Key 50); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this manufacturing BOM record in the source system. Used to detect changes during incremental data loads into the Databricks Silver Layer and to support BOM change history auditing required by IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; SAP PP BOM Change History; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The four-digit automotive Model Year (MY) for which this manufacturing BOM is valid (e.g., 2025). Determines the applicable regulatory standards, feature content, and homologation requirements. Aligns with NHTSA and EPA model year definitions.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 – VIN; SAP PP Material Master; IATF 16949

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle powertrain technology for which this BOM is defined. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine, HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle, PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle, BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle, FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Determines applicable emissions regulations (EPA, CARB, WLTP) and BOM component sets.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86 – Emissions Standards; CARB Title 13; CAFE Standards; SAE J1711

attributes.name: ppap_status
attributes.description: Status of the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) for the components in this BOM. PPAP is the AIAG/IATF 16949 process that verifies supplier components meet design and specification requirements before production launch. 'approved' is required before the BOM can be released to production.
attributes.references: AIAG PPAP 4th Edition; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4.1; SAP QM – Quality Notifications

attributes.name: predecessor_bom_number
attributes.description: BOM number of the previous manufacturing BOM version that this BOM supersedes. Enables backward navigation in the BOM version chain for change impact analysis and quality investigations. Null for the initial BOM version.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Change History; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: regulatory_market_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the target regulatory market for which this BOM is homologated (e.g., 'US-FEDERAL', 'US-CARB', 'EU-EURO6', 'JP-JC08', 'CN-CHINA6'). Determines applicable emissions standards (EPA, CARB, Euro 6, WLTP), safety regulations (NHTSA FMVSS, UNECE), and CAFE compliance requirements.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR – FMVSS; EPA 40 CFR Part 86; CARB Title 13; Euro NCAP; UNECE WP.29; CAFE Standards

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date on which this manufacturing BOM was formally released to production (status changed to 'released'). Marks the point at which the BOM is authorized for use in production orders and MRP planning. Corresponds to the SAP BOM release date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Release; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; APQP Phase 4

attributes.name: released_by
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the manufacturing engineer or release authority who formally released this BOM to production in SAP PP or Teamcenter PLM. Required for audit trail and change control compliance under IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; SAP PP Authorization; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Alphanumeric revision level of the BOM (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C' or '01', '02'). Used in conjunction with bom_version to track incremental changes within a version. Aligns with SAP BOM revision level and Teamcenter PLM revision management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Revision; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle program associated with this BOM. Marks the milestone when serial production begins using this BOM configuration. Critical for program management, supplier readiness, and PPAP completion tracking.
attributes.references: APQP Phase 4 – Product and Process Validation; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3; SAP PP Production Planning

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this manufacturing BOM record was sourced (e.g., 'SAP_PP' for SAP Production Planning, 'TEAMCENTER' for Siemens Teamcenter PLM). Required for data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and for resolving conflicts during BOM synchronization between PLM and ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; PTC Windchill; Dassault ENOVIA; Apriso MES

attributes.name: superseded_by_bom_number
attributes.description: BOM number of the newer manufacturing BOM that has replaced this one (populated when bom_status = 'superseded'). Enables forward navigation in the BOM version chain for traceability and historical analysis. Null when this is the current active BOM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Change History; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: vehicle_configuration_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific vehicle configuration (variant) for which this BOM is defined, including body style, drivetrain, trim level, and market variant (e.g., 'SUV-AWD-PREMIUM-NA'). Used in SAP Variant Configuration (VC) to select the correct BOM components for a specific vehicle order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Variant Configuration; Dassault ENOVIA Configuration Management; IATF 16949

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal OEM code identifying the vehicle model (nameplate) for which this mBOM is defined (e.g., 'F150', 'RAV4', 'MODEL3'). Used to associate the BOM with the correct vehicle program in PLM and SAP.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Product Structure; SAP PP Material Master

products.name: bom_component
products.description: Line-item record within a manufacturing BOM representing a single component or sub-assembly required to build a vehicle. Captures component part number, description, quantity per vehicle, unit of measure, installation work center, installation sequence, alternative part references, effectivity start/end dates, and scrap factor. Supports JIT/JIS material call-offs and shop floor assembly instructions.
products.reference: SAP PP BOM Item / Teamcenter BOM Line

attributes.name: bom_component_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a single line-item record within a manufacturing Bill of Materials (BOM). Serves as the primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM Management

attributes.name: characteristic_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.characteristic. Business justification: Each BOM component has associated quality characteristics (dimensional, functional, safety) per IATF 16949. Linking component to characteristic enables component-level quality control planning and sup

attributes.name: inbound_part_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_part. Business justification: Each BOM component maps to a specific supplier inbound part for MRP calloff generation, PPAP status tracking per component, and supplier corrective action traceability. supplier_part_number is a denor

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: Component Specification Process tracks components per vehicle model, enabling model‑specific quality and cost analysis.

attributes.name: part_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.part_master. Business justification: BOM components need a direct link to part_master for detailed specs; part_number/description are denormalized and will be removed.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or assembly facility where this BOM component is consumed. Determines plant-specific BOM validity and material availability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Organizational Structure; IATF 16949

attributes.name: production_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent BOM header to which this component line-item belongs. Links the component to its governing vehicle or sub-assembly BOM structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-BOM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM Management

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sku_master. Business justification: Each BOM component must map to an inventory SKU for procurement planning, backflushing, and MRP explosion. This is a foundational link in automotive manufacturing — component-level inventory managemen

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: BOM components are staged at specific lineside supply areas / storage locations for JIT/JIS delivery to assembly stations. supply_area is a denormalized storage location reference. This FK enables lin

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shop floor work center (e.g., stamping, body shop, paint, final assembly station) where this component is installed or consumed during vehicle build.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center; Apriso/Dassault MES Shop Floor Execution

attributes.name: alternate_part_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the alternate item group to which this component belongs in the BOM. Components within the same alternate group are interchangeable. Used in SAP BOM alternative item management for production flexibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-BOM Alternative Item Group

attributes.name: alternate_part_number
attributes.description: OEM part number of an approved alternate or substitute component that can be used in place of the primary part when the primary is unavailable. Supports supply chain continuity and JIT material substitution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Substitute Materials; PTC Windchill Parts Classification

attributes.name: backflush_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is backflushed (automatically goods-issued upon production order confirmation) rather than requiring a discrete goods movement transaction. True = backflush; False = manual goods issue required. Common for bulk and low-value components.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Backflushing; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: bom_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical depth of this component within the multi-level BOM structure. Level 0 is the finished vehicle; level 1 is a major assembly; deeper levels represent sub-assemblies and individual parts. Used for BOM explosion and cost rollup.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Multi-Level BOM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM Management

attributes.name: bulk_material_indicator
attributes.description: Flags this component as a bulk material (e.g., adhesives, lubricants, fasteners) that is issued to the production order without discrete picking or goods movement. Bulk materials are typically excluded from MRP individual requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-BOM Bulk Material; MRP

attributes.name: co_product_indicator
attributes.description: Flags this BOM item as a co-product or by-product that is produced alongside the primary output (e.g., stamping offcuts, recycled materials). Co-products receive a portion of the production order cost allocation.

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Procurement commodity classification code grouping this component into a spend category (e.g., 'ELEC-ECU', 'BODY-STAMPING', 'POWERTRAIN-EV-BATTERY'). Used in supply chain management (SCM), RFQ processes, and supplier performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group; PTC Windchill Parts Classification; SCM; RFQ

attributes.name: component_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this BOM component line. 'superseded' indicates the part has been replaced by an alternate; 'pending_approval' indicates the component is awaiting PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) sign-off before use in production.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Status; IATF 16949 PPAP; APQP

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM item indicating how it is sourced and consumed in the manufacturing process. 'phantom' denotes a logical grouping with no physical stock; 'bulk_material' denotes items issued without discrete picking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_material|purchased_part|sub_assembly|phantom|co_product|bulk_material — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM BOM Item Category; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BOM component record was first created in the source system (SAP or Teamcenter PLM). Provides audit trail for BOM change history and regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 Documented Information; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the standard cost value (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY'). Enables multi-currency BOM cost analysis across global manufacturing plants.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency; EBITDA

attributes.name: drawing_number
attributes.description: Reference to the CAD/CAE engineering drawing or 3D model document number associated with this component, as managed in CATIA/ENOVIA or PTC Windchill. Enables traceability from the manufacturing BOM back to the design definition.
attributes.references: Dassault Systèmes CATIA/ENOVIA; PTC Windchill Engineering Data Management; SAE International

attributes.name: drawing_revision
attributes.description: Revision level of the engineering drawing or CAD model applicable to this BOM component (e.g., 'A', 'B', '01'). Ensures the correct design revision is used in production and supports PPAP documentation.
attributes.references: Dassault Systèmes CATIA/ENOVIA; PTC Windchill; IATF 16949 PPAP

attributes.name: effectivity_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this BOM component line is no longer valid and should be excluded from production builds. Null indicates an open-ended validity. Supports EOP (End of Production) transitions and engineering change cutover.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-BOM Validity; Siemens Teamcenter PLM Engineering Change; EOP

attributes.name: effectivity_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this BOM component line is valid and should be included in production builds. Supports engineering change management and model year (MY) transitions. Components before this date are not called off.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-BOM Validity; Siemens Teamcenter PLM Engineering Change; SOP

attributes.name: engineering_change_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Notice (ECN) or Engineering Change Order (ECO) that introduced or last modified this BOM component line. Provides full traceability of design changes from PLM through to the manufacturing BOM.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Engineering Change; PTC Windchill Engineering Data Management; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3.6

attributes.name: fmea_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) Reference
attributes.description: Document reference number for the Design FMEA (DFMEA) or Process FMEA (PFMEA) associated with this component. Supports APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) traceability and IATF 16949 risk management requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3.3; FMEA; APQP; SAE J1739

attributes.name: hazardous_material_indicator
attributes.description: Flags this component as containing hazardous materials subject to regulatory controls (e.g., lead, cadmium, hexavalent chromium under EU ELV Directive, or lithium battery cells under UN 38.3). Triggers special handling, storage, and disposal procedures.
attributes.references: EU ELV Directive 2000/53/EC; EU RoHS Directive; UNECE; EPA; DOT FMVSS

attributes.name: installation_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence defining the order in which this component is installed relative to other components at the same work center. Critical for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) material call-offs and shop floor assembly instruction generation.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES JIS Sequencing; SAP S/4HANA PP Routing

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: SAP BOM item category code indicating how the component is managed in inventory and procurement (e.g., stock item 'L', non-stock item 'N', variable-size item 'R'). Drives material requirements planning (MRP) and goods movement behavior.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-BOM Item Category; MRP

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this BOM component record in the source system. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and BOM audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 Documented Information; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents

attributes.name: lead_offset_days
attributes.description: Number of days before or after the parent order start date that this component must be available at the work center. Negative values indicate the component must arrive before the order start. Used in JIT/JIS scheduling and MRP net requirements calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Lead Time Offset; JIT; JIS

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Four-digit vehicle model year (MY) for which this BOM component is applicable (e.g., '2025'). Used to filter BOM components during model year changeover, SOP (Start of Production) planning, and regulatory homologation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-BOM; NHTSA FMVSS; MY

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: Four-digit SAP routing operation number to which this BOM component is assigned. Links the component to the specific assembly step in the production routing, enabling shop floor assembly instruction generation and MES work order sequencing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Routing; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: phantom_assembly_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is a phantom assembly — a logical grouping used for BOM structuring that has no physical stock or production order. MRP explodes through phantom assemblies to plan the underlying components directly.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-BOM Phantom Assembly; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: ppap_status
attributes.description: Current PPAP approval status for this component, indicating whether the supplier has received production part approval from the OEM quality team. Components without approved PPAP status cannot be used in series production. Aligns with IATF 16949 requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.4.1; PPAP; APQP; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: priority_in_alt_group
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank of this component within its alternate item group. Lower numbers indicate higher preference. MRP uses this priority to determine which alternate to consume first when multiple substitutes are available.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-BOM Alternative Item Priority; MRP

attributes.name: quantity_per_vehicle
attributes.description: Number of units of this component required to build one complete vehicle or parent assembly. Supports fractional quantities for bulk materials (e.g., 0.5 litres of adhesive). Used in MRP material call-off calculations and JIT/JIS scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-BOM Component Quantity; MRP; JIT/JIS

attributes.name: reach_svhc_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: REACH Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component contains a Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) as defined under EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006. Required for regulatory compliance reporting and customer disclosure obligations.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; UNECE; ISO 14001

attributes.name: scrap_factor_pct
attributes.description: Expected percentage of this component that will be scrapped during the manufacturing process, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 2.5000 = 2.5%). Used to inflate the planned component quantity in MRP to account for anticipated process losses. Supports PPM (Parts Per Million) defect tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-BOM Scrap Factor; IATF 16949 Clause 10.2; PPM

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost per unit of this component in the plant currency, as maintained in the SAP material master cost estimate. Used in production order cost rollup, BOM cost analysis, and EBITDA reporting. Classified confidential as it contains sensitive pricing data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Product Costing; EBITDA; CapEx

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: ISO unit of measure code for the component quantity (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, L for litre, M for metre, M2 for square metre). Aligns with SAP base unit of measure in the material master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; ISO 80000; IATF 16949

attributes.name: usage_probability_pct
attributes.description: Probability (0–100%) that this component will actually be consumed in a given build, used for optional or variant-dependent components. Supports MRP planning for configurable vehicles where not every component is installed on every unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-BOM Component Probability; Siemens Teamcenter PLM Configuration Management

attributes.name: variant_condition
attributes.description: Boolean or characteristic-based condition expression that determines when this component is included in a configurable BOM (e.g., 'ENGINE_TYPE = V8 AND MARKET = USA'). Used in SAP Variant Configuration and Teamcenter product configuration management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Variant Configuration; Siemens Teamcenter PLM Configuration Management; Dassault ENOVIA

attributes.name: vehicle_program_code
attributes.description: Internal OEM code identifying the vehicle program or platform to which this BOM component applies (e.g., 'F150-GEN14', 'EV-PLATFORM-X'). Supports multi-platform BOM management and cross-program parts commonality analysis.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Configuration Management; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of a single unit of this component in kilograms. Used in vehicle weight calculations, CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) compliance modelling, NVH (Noise Vibration Harshness) analysis, and logistics planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master Weight; CAFE; WLTP; EPA; NVH

products.name: material_consumption
products.description: Transactional record capturing actual material consumption (goods issue) against a production order on the shop floor. Tracks consumed part number, quantity consumed, unit of measure, consumption timestamp, work center, production order reference, storage location, batch number, and variance from planned BOM quantity. Feeds SAP MM goods movement and cost accounting for production variance reporting.

attributes.name: material_consumption_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each material consumption (goods issue) transaction record on the shop floor. Primary key of this table.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module – Goods Movement

attributes.name: bom_component_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_bom_component. Business justification: Material consumption records capture actual goods issues against specific BOM components. The bom_item_number STRING is a denormalized reference to the manufacturing_bom_component. Adding manufacturin

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Material consumption postings (goods issues to production) generate FI documents against specific GL accounts (raw material consumption, WIP inventory accounts). SAP MM-FI integration mandates GL acco

attributes.name: inbound_part_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_part. Business justification: Material consumption reports must reference the specific inbound part receipt to calculate usage rates and supplier performance metrics.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Material consumption references the inspection lot for the consumed batch/component. Existing 'quality_inspection_lot' is denormalized. Proper FK enables incoming material quality traceability during

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the material consumption occurred. Aligns with SAP organizational unit for plant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Plant Organizational Unit

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order against which this material was consumed. Links consumption to the manufacturing work order in SAP PP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – Production Order

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the consumed part or component. Corresponds to the SAP Material Master (MM) object.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location (bin, supermarket, line-side buffer) from which the material was issued for consumption.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Material consumption traceability per VIN is a regulatory requirement under IATF 16949 and NHTSA recall regulations — manufacturers must identify which specific components were consumed in building ea

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (assembly station, stamping cell, paint booth, etc.) on the shop floor where the material was consumed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Work Center; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: assembly_station_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific assembly station or line position (JIS – Just-in-Sequence station) where the material was consumed. More granular than work center; used for shop floor traceability.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Supplier or internal batch/lot number of the consumed material. Critical for traceability, recall management, and IATF 16949 batch traceability requirements. Nullable for non-batch-managed materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Batch Management (CHARG); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version or revision of the BOM used at the time of consumption. Supports engineering change management and ensures consumption is reconciled against the correct BOM revision.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Version; SAP S/4HANA PP – Alternative BOM

attributes.name: consumption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the material consumption record. 'posted' = goods issue confirmed in SAP; 'reversed' = goods issue reversed (movement type 262); 'blocked' = held for quality review; 'pending' = awaiting MES confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Goods Movement Status; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: consumption_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the material was physically issued from stock and consumed at the work center on the shop floor. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Posting Date/Time; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: cost_variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the consumption variance (actual cost minus planned cost) in plant currency. Positive = cost overrun; negative = cost saving. Key metric for production cost variance reporting in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Production Variance (KKBC_ORD); IATF 16949

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this material consumption record was first created in the source system (SAP MM or MES). Audit trail field for data lineage and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Creation Timestamp; IATF 16949 Record Retention

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the material cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Supports multi-currency manufacturing operations across global plants.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 – Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: goods_movement_number
attributes.description: Externally visible SAP material document number generated when the goods issue (movement type 261) is posted. Serves as the business-facing transaction identifier traceable in SAP MM.

attributes.name: goods_movement_type
attributes.description: SAP movement type code indicating the nature of the goods movement (e.g., 261 = goods issue to production order, 262 = reversal, 291 = goods issue to cost center). Drives inventory and cost accounting postings.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this material consumption record in the source system. Used for incremental data load detection and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Change Timestamp; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: material_cost_amount
attributes.description: Standard cost value of the consumed material quantity at the time of goods issue, expressed in the plant currency. Calculated as quantity consumed × standard price from SAP Material Master. Feeds production cost accounting and variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Standard Cost; FI Goods Issue Valuation

attributes.name: mes_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the Apriso/Dassault MES system that triggered or confirmed this material consumption event. Enables cross-system reconciliation between MES shop floor execution and SAP MM goods movements.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Transaction ID; SAP S/4HANA MM Integration

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The model year (MY) of the vehicle being assembled (e.g., '2025'). Used for model-year-level consumption analysis, BOM alignment, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Model Year; NHTSA MY Definition

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: The routing operation number within the production order at which the material was consumed (e.g., operation 0010 = body shop, 0020 = paint, 0030 = final assembly). Enables process-step-level consumption analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Routing Operation (VORNR); Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: original_goods_movement_number
attributes.description: Reference to the original SAP material document number that this record reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Enables audit trail for reversed consumption transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Reversal Reference Document

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: The planned quantity of this material as specified in the Bill of Materials (BOM) for the production order. Used to calculate consumption variance against actual quantity consumed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Component Quantity; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting posting date for the goods issue in SAP, which may differ from the physical consumption timestamp. Used for period-end cost accounting and production variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO – Posting Date; IATF 16949

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain type of the vehicle being assembled: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), EV (Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives BOM variant selection and consumption expectations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Configuration; CAFE/EPA Powertrain Classification

attributes.name: production_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the production line (e.g., 'LINE-A', 'TRIM-2', 'PAINT-EAST') where the material was consumed. Used for line-level consumption analysis and capacity planning.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Production Line; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: quantity_consumed
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the material consumed (goods issued) against the production order. Expressed in the base unit of measure of the material. Core quantitative fact for this transaction.

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: Difference between actual quantity consumed and planned BOM quantity (actual minus planned). Positive value indicates over-consumption; negative indicates under-consumption. Key input for production variance reporting and cost accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Production Variance; IATF 16949 SPC

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this consumption record is a reversal (cancellation) of a previously posted goods issue. True = this is a reversal document; False = original consumption posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Reversal Document (STORNO); Goods Movement

attributes.name: scrap_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the consumed material was scrapped (True) rather than incorporated into the vehicle assembly. Scrap consumption is tracked separately for waste reporting, IATF 16949 scrap analysis, and environmental compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Scrap; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; ISO 14001

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for material scrap when scrap_indicator is True (e.g., 'DAMAGE', 'DEFECT', 'WRONG_PART', 'PROCESS_LOSS'). Used for scrap root cause analysis and PPM defect rate reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DAMAGE|DEFECT|WRONG_PART|PROCESS_LOSS|HANDLING_ERROR|SUPPLIER_DEFECT|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Scrap Reason; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; FMEA

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Individual serial number of the consumed component where serial number management is active (e.g., ECU, battery module, transmission). Enables unit-level traceability for safety-critical parts. Nullable for non-serialized materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Serial Number Management; NHTSA Traceability Requirements

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Production shift during which the material was consumed (DAY, AFTERNOON, NIGHT). Used for shift-level consumption analysis, variance trending, and workforce productivity reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this consumption record originated (SAP_MM = SAP S/4HANA MM goods movement, MES_APRISO = Apriso/Dassault MES, SAP_PP = SAP Production Planning, MANUAL = manual entry). Supports data lineage in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer – Data Lineage; SAP S/4HANA Integration

attributes.name: supplier_number
attributes.description: SAP vendor/supplier number of the supplier who provided the consumed material. Used for supplier-level consumption analysis, PPAP traceability, and supply chain variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Vendor Master (LFA1); IATF 16949 Supplier Management

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the consumed quantity (e.g., EA = each, KG = kilogram, L = litre, M = metre, PC = piece). Aligns with SAP base UoM from Material Master. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|M2|M3|PC|SET|ROL|BOX — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Base Unit of Measure (MEINS); ISO 80000

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: Quantity variance expressed as a percentage of the planned BOM quantity ((actual - planned) / planned × 100). Used for threshold-based alerting and PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – Variance Analysis; IATF 16949

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal OEM code identifying the vehicle model or platform being assembled (e.g., 'F150', 'CAMRY-HEV', 'SILVERADO-EV'). Used for model-level consumption aggregation and BOM variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Material (Finished Vehicle); Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: wip_order_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential position of this consumption event within the production order's WIP (Work in Progress) processing sequence. Used for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) ordering analysis and shop floor flow traceability.

products.name: rework_order
products.description: Transactional record for rework or repair operations initiated on a vehicle or sub-assembly that failed an in-process quality check. Captures rework order number, originating production order, VIN reference, defect description, rework type (in-line repair, offline rework, teardown), assigned work center, planned and actual rework hours, rework status, and disposition (repaired, scrapped, concession). Integrates with quality domain defect records.
products.reference: Apriso MES Rework / SAP QM Rework Order

attributes.name: rework_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the rework order record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7 - Control of Nonconforming Outputs

attributes.name: build_stage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.build_stage. Business justification: Rework orders are initiated at a specific build stage where the defect was detected or where rework is performed. The assembly_stage_code STRING is a denormalized reference to the build_stage master.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Rework labor and material costs must be posted to a cost center for quality cost reporting, warranty reserve calculations, and IATF 16949 quality cost analysis. Automotive quality controllers require

attributes.name: defect_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality defect record in the quality domain that triggered this rework order. Links rework traceability to the originating inspection finding or defect notification.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP QM Defect Record

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Rework costs (labor and material) are posted to specific GL accounts (quality cost expense, scrap/rework accounts) for P&L reporting and cost-of-poor-quality analysis. Automotive finance requires GL-l

attributes.name: inbound_part_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_part. Business justification: Rework orders caused by defective inbound parts require traceability to the specific supplier part for SCAR issuance, PPAP re-submission triggers, and warranty cost recovery from suppliers. This is a

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: After rework completion, a re-inspection lot is created to verify rework effectiveness. re_inspection_required field on rework_order indicates this need. Linking to inspection_lot enables rework verif

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the rework operation is being executed. Aligns with SAP Plant (Werk) organizational unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure; IATF 16949 Section 4.1

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating production order from which this rework order was raised. Links the rework event back to the scheduled manufacturing work order in SAP PP or MES.
attributes.references: SAP PP Production Order; IATF 16949 Section 8.5.1

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sku_master. Business justification: Rework orders consume replacement parts that must be issued from inventory and tracked against specific SKUs for cost accounting, material replenishment triggering, and IATF 16949 quality cost reporti

attributes.name: vehicle_build_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.vehicle_build. Business justification: A rework_order is initiated on a specific vehicle_build that failed quality inspection. The vin STRING column is a denormalized vehicle identifier; replacing it with vehicle_build_id FK provides direc

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or repair station assigned to execute the rework operation. Corresponds to SAP PP Work Center or MES work station definition.
attributes.references: SAP PP Work Center; Apriso/Dassault MES Work Station

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the rework operation was completed and the unit was released for re-inspection or returned to the production line. Recorded by MES upon order closure.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES Time Tracking; SAP PM Order Confirmation

attributes.name: actual_rework_hours
attributes.description: Actual labor hours consumed to complete the rework operation, recorded upon order completion in MES or SAP PM. Compared against planned hours for efficiency analysis and cost variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP PM Actual Costs; Apriso/Dassault MES Time Tracking; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the rework technician began executing the rework operation, as recorded by MES shop floor data collection or operator confirmation.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES Time Tracking; SAP PM Order Confirmation

attributes.name: bom_component_number
attributes.description: The BOM (Bill of Materials) component or part number of the specific sub-assembly or component requiring rework. References the engineering BOM managed in Siemens Teamcenter or SAP MM.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM Management; SAP MM Material Master; IATF 16949 Section 8.5.1

attributes.name: corrective_action_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the corrective action (CAR) or 8D problem-solving report raised in response to this rework event. Links the rework order to the formal quality improvement process.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 10.2.1 - Corrective Action; SAP QM Corrective Action; APQP 8D Report

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rework order record was first created in the source system (MES or SAP QM). Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 7.5 - Documented Information; ISO 9001:2015 Section 7.5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary cost fields on this rework order (rework_labor_cost, rework_material_cost). Typically the plant's local operating currency (e.g., USD, EUR, MXN).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: defect_code
attributes.description: Standardized defect classification code identifying the type of nonconformance that triggered the rework order. Aligns with the plant defect code catalogue maintained in SAP QM or MES quality module.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP QM Defect Code Catalogue

attributes.name: defect_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the defect or nonconformance identified during in-process quality inspection that initiated this rework order. Captured by the quality inspector or MES operator.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP QM Notification Long Text

attributes.name: defect_location_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the physical location or zone on the vehicle or sub-assembly where the defect was found (e.g., body zone, paint zone, chassis area). Used for spatial defect analysis and NVH (Noise Vibration Harshness) correlation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; Euro NCAP Defect Zone Classification

attributes.name: detection_method_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the method by which the defect was detected prior to rework order creation (e.g., visual inspection, automated gauge check, functional test, quality audit, customer feedback). Supports FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) detection ranking analysis.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.6; FMEA Detection Ranking; SAP QM Inspection Method

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the nonconformance was originally detected during in-process quality inspection, triggering the creation of this rework order. The principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.6; SAP QM Inspection Lot Creation Date; Apriso MES Quality Event

attributes.name: disposition_code
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the nonconforming unit after rework evaluation. Repaired indicates successful correction; scrapped indicates the unit is unrecoverable; concession (use-as-is) indicates acceptance of the nonconformance with documented deviation; return to supplier applies to purchased components.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7.1 - Disposition of Nonconforming Product; ISO 9001:2015 Section 8.7

attributes.name: inspection_point_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific quality inspection checkpoint or gate (e.g., body-in-white audit, paint final audit, end-of-line check) at which the defect was detected and the rework order was initiated.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.6; SAP QM Inspection Lot; Apriso MES Quality Gate

attributes.name: is_regulatory_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle or sub-assembly is placed on a regulatory hold pending rework completion and re-inspection. A regulatory hold prevents the unit from advancing to the next production stage or shipping.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 573; CARB Compliance; DOT FMVSS; IATF 16949 Section 8.7

attributes.name: is_safety_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the defect triggering this rework order is classified as safety-critical, requiring escalation per NHTSA, DOT, or internal safety reporting protocols. Safety-related rework orders may trigger FMEA review and potential field action assessment.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 573 - Defect and Noncompliance Reports; DOT FMVSS; IATF 16949 Section 9.1.3

attributes.name: line_stoppage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rework event caused a production line stoppage (Andon pull or line stop). Used for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) impact analysis and production downtime reporting.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.5.1; Apriso/Dassault MES Andon Event; SAP PP Downtime Recording

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) of the unit undergoing rework. Used for regulatory compliance reporting, warranty analysis, and production quality trending by model year.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAP PP Production Version

attributes.name: planned_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the rework operation is planned to be completed. Used to calculate planned rework cycle time and assess impact on downstream production sequencing.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES Scheduling; SAP PP Scheduling

attributes.name: planned_rework_hours
attributes.description: Estimated labor hours planned to complete the rework operation, as defined in the rework routing or standard repair time (SRT) catalogue. Used for capacity planning and cost estimation.
attributes.references: SAP PP Routing Standard Values; IATF 16949 Section 8.5.1

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the rework operation is planned to begin, as determined by the MES scheduler or production planner. Used for shop floor capacity planning and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) scheduling.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES Scheduling; SAP PP Scheduling

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the rework order to drive scheduling and resource allocation on the shop floor. Critical priority typically indicates a safety-related or regulatory nonconformance requiring immediate resolution.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP QM Notification Priority

attributes.name: production_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific production line (e.g., stamping, body shop, paint, final assembly) where the defect was originally detected and the rework order was raised.
