attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES Production Line Configuration; SAP PP Work Center Hierarchy

attributes.name: re_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal re-inspection is required after rework completion before the unit can be released to the next production stage or shipped. Mandatory for safety-related or regulatory nonconformances.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7.1; SAP QM Re-Inspection Trigger

attributes.name: re_inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the quality re-inspection performed after rework completion. Pass indicates the unit meets specification; fail triggers a secondary rework or scrap decision; conditional pass indicates acceptance with documented deviation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.6; SAP QM Usage Decision; Apriso MES Quality Gate Result

attributes.name: rework_attempt_count
attributes.description: Number of rework attempts made on this unit or component for the same defect. Multiple rework attempts on the same unit indicate a chronic quality issue and may trigger escalation or scrap decision per quality policy.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7.1; SAP QM Notification Recurrence

attributes.name: rework_instruction_reference
attributes.description: Document number or reference to the approved rework instruction, repair standard, or Technical Service Bulletin (TSB) that governs the rework procedure. Ensures traceability to authorized repair methods.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.5.1; SAP DMS Document Reference; Siemens Teamcenter Document Management

attributes.name: rework_labor_cost
attributes.description: Total internal labor cost incurred for the rework operation, calculated from actual rework hours and the applicable labor rate. Expressed in the plant's operating currency. Used for quality cost (Cost of Poor Quality - COPQ) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Object Controlling; IATF 16949 Section 9.1; APQP Cost of Poor Quality

attributes.name: rework_material_cost
attributes.description: Cost of replacement parts and materials consumed during the rework operation. Sourced from SAP MM goods issue postings against the rework order. Contributes to total Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) calculation.
attributes.references: SAP MM Goods Issue; SAP CO Cost Object; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: rework_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the rework order, typically generated by the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) or SAP QM module. Format: RWK-{PlantCode}-{Year}-{Sequence}.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP QM Notification Number

attributes.name: rework_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rework order within the shop floor execution workflow. Tracks progression from creation through completion or cancellation as managed in MES or SAP QM.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; Apriso/Dassault MES Order Status

attributes.name: rework_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rework operation method. Inline repair is performed on the moving assembly line; offline rework removes the unit from the line; teardown involves partial or full disassembly; subassembly rework targets a component before vehicle integration; cosmetic repair addresses surface or finish defects. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: inline_repair|offline_rework|teardown|subassembly_rework|cosmetic_repair|field_return_rework — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7.1; APQP Phase 4 - Product and Process Validation

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the root cause of the defect as determined through root cause analysis (e.g., 5-Why, Ishikawa). Populated upon rework completion. Supports FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) and SPC (Statistical Process Control) improvement actions.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 10.2; FMEA Methodology; SAP QM Cause Code

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: Number of components or sub-assemblies scrapped as a result of this rework order where repair was not feasible. Used for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation and scrap cost reporting.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP PP Scrap Posting; PPM Defect Rate Reporting

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this rework order record was sourced (e.g., SAP QM, Apriso/Dassault MES, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer ingestion traceability.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance - Data Lineage Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Conventions

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rework order record was last modified in the source system. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 7.5 - Documented Information; ISO 9001:2015 Section 7.5

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal product/model code identifying the vehicle nameplate or platform (e.g., truck, SUV, EV, HEV) associated with the rework order. Aligns with PLM product structure in Siemens Teamcenter.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM Product Structure; SAP MM Material Master

products.name: production_confirmation
products.description: Transactional record confirming the completion of a production order or a partial operation within a production order. Captures confirmation number, production order reference, confirmed quantity (yield and scrap), actual activity times (setup, machine, labor), confirmation timestamp, shift, work center, and operator. Triggers SAP PP order settlement and inventory goods receipt. SSOT for actual production output reporting.

attributes.name: production_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the production confirmation record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity. Entity Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete business event (completion of a production order or partial operation) with a clear lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — CO11N/CO15 Confirmation Object

attributes.name: build_stage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.build_stage. Business justification: A production_confirmation records completion of a specific operation at a build stage. The assembly_stage STRING is a denormalized reference to the build_stage master. Adding build_stage_id FK enables

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Activity confirmations post actual labor and machine costs to cost centers in the SAP CO module. production_confirmation.cost_center_code is a denormalized plain attribute; replacing it with a proper

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Production confirmations trigger goods receipt and activity cost postings in SAP; they must be tied to fiscal periods for period-end cutoff, production cost settlement, and monthly closing. Automotive

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: SAP QM standard: production confirmations create inspection lots for in-process quality. Existing 'quality_inspection_lot' is a denormalized lot number; proper FK to inspection_lot.inspection_lot_id e

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this production confirmation was posted. Enables plant-level production output reporting, capacity utilization analysis, and multi-plant benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Plant (WERKS); ISO 14001 Facility Identification

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_order. Business justification: A production_confirmation confirms the completion of a production_order. The production_order_number STRING column is a denormalized reference; replacing it with a proper FK production_order_id normal

attributes.name: reversed_confirmation_production_confirmation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original production confirmation record that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True. Enables audit trail reconstruction and net quantity calculation when reversals are present. Self-referencing within the production_confirmation product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — CO13 Reversal Reference; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 Traceability

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which this confirmation was recorded. Enables shift-level production output analysis, yield comparison across shifts, and workforce productivity reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift (SCHICHT); Apriso MES Shift Management

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: Production confirmations post goods receipts to specific storage locations (SAP GR posting). storage_location_code is a denormalized reference. This FK is required for accurate inventory posting, WIP-

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center (SAP ARBPL) where the confirmed operation was executed. Work centers represent physical production resources such as stamping presses, welding stations, paint booths, or assembly lines. Used for capacity reporting and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center (ARBPL); IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3 Infrastructure

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: SAP CO activity type (LSTAR) used to record the confirmed actual activities (setup, machine, labor) against the production order. Drives cost settlement rates and actual cost calculation in SAP CO-PC (Product Costing). Required for standard vs. actual cost variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC — Activity Type (LSTAR); IATF 16949 Clause 9.1.3

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which yield, scrap, and rework quantities are expressed. Typically 'EA' (Each) for vehicles and assemblies, 'PC' (Piece) for components, 'KG' for weight-based materials. Maps to SAP MM/PP base unit of measure (MEINS). Required for correct inventory posting and quantity reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|L|M|SET|VH — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Base Unit of Measure (MEINS); ISO 80000 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: SAP batch number (CHARG) assigned to the confirmed production output. Used for batch-managed materials to enable full forward and backward traceability of components and finished vehicles. Critical for recall management, warranty analysis, and regulatory compliance with NHTSA traceability requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP — Batch Number (CHARG); NHTSA 49 CFR Part 573 Recall Traceability; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: confirmation_entry_mode
attributes.description: Method by which this production confirmation was entered into SAP PP. 'manual' = entered by operator via CO11N; 'automatic' = system-generated via PP-PI or SCADA integration; 'mes_interface' = posted via Apriso/Dassault MES interface; 'backflush' = automatic backflush confirmation triggered by goods issue. Used for data quality auditing and process automation tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Confirmation Entry Mode; Apriso MES Integration; SCADA Interface

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric confirmation number assigned by SAP PP (CO11N) at the time of posting. This is the business-facing identifier used in shop floor reporting, MES integration, and order settlement reconciliation. Maps to SAP field RUECK (Confirmation Number).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — CO11N Confirmation Number (RUECK); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 Traceability

attributes.name: confirmation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production confirmation record. 'created' = confirmation entered but not yet posted; 'posted' = successfully posted to SAP PP and inventory updated; 'reversed' = confirmation reversed via CO13; 'cancelled' = voided before posting; 'partial' = partial quantity confirmed, order still open; 'final' = final confirmation closing the production order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Confirmation Status (CO11N/CO13); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world event timestamp recording when the production operation or order was confirmed as complete on the shop floor. This is the business event time (not the system posting time) and represents the actual completion moment. Maps to SAP PP fields BUDAT (posting date) + ISDD/ISDZ (actual execution date/time). Used for takt time analysis, shift output reporting, and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — CO11N Actual Execution Timestamp (ISDD/ISDZ); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: confirmation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the confirmation indicating whether it is a partial confirmation (interim progress), final confirmation (order completion), automatic system-generated confirmation, milestone-based confirmation, or a reversal entry. Determines downstream SAP PP processing logic including order closure and goods receipt.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Confirmation Category (STOKZ); Apriso MES Confirmation Type

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this production confirmation record was first created in the source system (SAP PP or MES). Represents the system audit creation time, distinct from the confirmation_timestamp (business event time). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA monitoring of confirmation posting latency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Record Creation Timestamp; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 Documented Information

attributes.name: downtime_duration_min
attributes.description: Total unplanned downtime duration recorded during this production confirmation period, in minutes. Captured from SCADA/PLC systems or MES downtime tracking. Used for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) availability calculation, maintenance planning, and production loss analysis.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Downtime Tracking; SCADA Integration; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

attributes.name: downtime_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for any downtime recorded during this confirmation period. Maps to the plant's downtime reason catalog (e.g., 'MECH' = Mechanical Failure, 'MATL' = Material Shortage, 'QUAL' = Quality Hold, 'CHNG' = Changeover). Used for root cause analysis, maintenance prioritization, and production loss reporting.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Downtime Reason Catalog; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3; SAP PM Integration

attributes.name: final_confirmation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this confirmation is the final confirmation for the production order (SAP PP IEDD — Final Confirmation Indicator). When True, SAP PP automatically closes the production order, triggers goods receipt for the finished product, and initiates order settlement to CO (Controlling). Critical for order lifecycle management and inventory accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Final Confirmation Indicator (IEDD); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: goods_receipt_posted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the automatic goods receipt (GR) to inventory has been successfully posted as a result of this production confirmation. True = inventory has been updated with the confirmed yield quantity. Used for inventory reconciliation and to identify confirmations where GR posting failed or is pending.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM — Goods Receipt (MIGO/MB31); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: labor_time_actual_min
attributes.description: Actual direct labor time consumed for this production operation, recorded in minutes. Maps to SAP PP activity type for labor (ISRLA — Actual Labor Time). Used for labor cost settlement to the production order, workforce productivity analysis, and standard vs. actual cost variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Actual Labor Time (ISRLA); IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.2 People

attributes.name: labor_time_planned_min
attributes.description: Planned direct labor time for this operation as defined in the SAP PP routing, recorded in minutes. Baseline for labor efficiency variance analysis and standard cost calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Routing Planned Labor Time; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this production confirmation record was last modified in the source system. Tracks reversals, corrections, and status updates. Used for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and change data capture (CDC) processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Record Change Timestamp; Databricks Delta Lake CDC; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: machine_time_actual_min
attributes.description: Actual machine runtime consumed for this production operation, recorded in minutes. Maps to SAP PP activity type for machine time (ISRÜT — Actual Machine Time). Core input for OEE calculation, takt time variance analysis, and capacity utilization reporting. Compared against planned machine time from the routing to identify bottlenecks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Actual Machine Time (ISRÜT); IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3; OEE Standard

attributes.name: machine_time_planned_min
attributes.description: Planned machine time for this operation as defined in the SAP PP routing, recorded in minutes. Baseline for actual vs. planned machine time variance analysis and takt time adherence reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Routing Planned Machine Time; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number (MATNR) of the finished or semi-finished product being confirmed. Identifies the vehicle model, sub-assembly, or component produced in this confirmation. Essential for inventory goods receipt posting and BOM (Bill of Materials) reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP — Material Master (MATNR); ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: mes_confirmation_reference
attributes.description: The confirmation or transaction reference number from the Apriso/Dassault MES system that corresponds to this SAP PP production confirmation. Enables cross-system traceability between the MES shop floor execution record and the SAP ERP confirmation posting. Critical for audit trails and discrepancy resolution.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution Traceability; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) of the product being confirmed. Used for production output reporting by model year, regulatory compliance tracking (CAFE, EPA emissions), and alignment with SOP (Start of Production) and EOP (End of Production) milestones. Retained as a denormalized attribute for direct reporting without joining to vehicle configuration.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 — Model Year; CAFE Standards; EPA Emissions Reporting

attributes.name: operation_number
attributes.description: Routing operation number (VORNR) within the production order being confirmed. Identifies the specific manufacturing step (e.g., 0010 = Stamping, 0020 = Body Weld, 0030 = Paint, 0040 = Final Assembly) for partial confirmation scenarios. Maps to SAP PP routing operation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Routing Operation (VORNR); Apriso/Dassault MES Operation Sequence

attributes.name: order_settlement_status
attributes.description: Status of the SAP CO production order settlement triggered by this final confirmation. 'pending' = settlement not yet executed; 'settled' = actual costs fully settled to cost objects; 'partially_settled' = partial settlement completed; 'not_required' = non-final confirmation, settlement not applicable. Used for period-end closing and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC — Order Settlement (KO88); IATF 16949 Clause 9.1.3

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting/inventory posting date (SAP BUDAT) on which the production confirmation is financially posted. May differ from the confirmation timestamp when confirmations are entered retroactively. Drives inventory valuation, cost object settlement, and financial period assignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Posting Date (BUDAT); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: The powertrain technology type of the vehicle or assembly being confirmed. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine, HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle, PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle, BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle, FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Used for regulatory reporting (CAFE, EPA, CARB), EV production mix analysis, and R&D investment tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Act — Powertrain Classification; CARB ZEV Mandate; CAFE Standards; UNECE Regulations

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this confirmation record is a reversal entry (CO13 reversal in SAP PP). True = this record reverses a previously posted confirmation. Used to identify correction entries in production output reporting and to exclude reversed confirmations from yield and time aggregations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — CO13 Confirmation Reversal (STOKZ); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: rework_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units requiring rework (reprocessing to meet specification) identified during this confirmation. Distinct from scrap (which is permanently rejected). Used for quality cost analysis, rework labor tracking, and process capability assessment per APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Rework Quantity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7.1; APQP

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of units scrapped (rejected as non-conforming) during this production operation. Maps to SAP PP field XMNGA (Scrap Quantity). Used for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation, scrap cost reporting, and FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) input. Triggers quality notification creation when thresholds are exceeded.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/QM — Scrap Quantity (XMNGA); IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 Nonconforming Outputs; SPC

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for scrap recorded against this confirmation. Maps to SAP QM defect codes or MES scrap reason catalog (e.g., 'DIM' = Dimensional Non-conformance, 'WLD' = Weld Defect, 'PNT' = Paint Defect, 'ASY' = Assembly Error). Required for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect analysis, FMEA updates, and quality improvement initiatives per IATF 16949.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Defect Code (FEHLERNR); IATF 16949 Clause 8.7.1; APQP Control Plan

attributes.name: setup_time_actual_min
attributes.description: Actual machine/workstation setup time consumed for this operation, recorded in minutes. Maps to SAP PP activity type for setup (ISRST — Actual Setup Time). Used for capacity planning, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation, and comparison against planned setup time from the routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Actual Setup Time (ISRST); SAE J4000 Lean Manufacturing Assessment

attributes.name: setup_time_planned_min
attributes.description: Planned setup time for this operation as defined in the SAP PP routing, recorded in minutes. Provides the baseline for actual vs. planned setup time variance analysis. Sourced from the routing master data at the time of production order creation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Routing Planned Setup Time; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: takt_time_actual_sec
attributes.description: Actual takt time achieved for this production confirmation, expressed in seconds per unit. Calculated as total operation time divided by yield quantity. Used for production line balancing, bottleneck identification, and comparison against the planned takt time to assess line efficiency. Key metric in JIS (Just-in-Sequence) production management.
attributes.references: SAE J4000 Lean Manufacturing; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1; Apriso MES Takt Time Monitoring

attributes.name: teardown_time_actual_min
attributes.description: Actual teardown/cleanup time consumed after the production operation, recorded in minutes. Maps to SAP PP activity type for teardown. Included in total operation time for accurate takt time and capacity utilization calculations. Relevant for paint booth cleaning, tooling changeover, and AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) repositioning cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Actual Teardown Time; SAE J4000

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number assigned to the vehicle unit confirmed in this production record. Populated for final assembly confirmations where a specific vehicle unit is produced. Null for sub-assembly or component-level confirmations. Enables full build traceability from production confirmation to vehicle delivery.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 — VIN Standard; ISO 3779 Vehicle Identification Number; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: yield_quantity
attributes.description: The confirmed good quantity (yield) produced in this confirmation, expressed in the base unit of measure of the material. Represents the number of units that passed quality inspection and are accepted into inventory. Maps to SAP PP field LMNGA (Yield Quantity). Core metric for production output reporting and OTD (On-Time Delivery) tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Yield Quantity (LMNGA); IATF 16949 Clause 9.1.1 Monitoring and Measurement

products.name: capacity_plan
products.description: Master record for plant and line capacity planning, capturing planned production capacity by plant, production line, shift pattern, and planning period (weekly/monthly). Includes rated capacity (JPH × available hours), demonstrated capacity, capacity utilization percentage, bottleneck work center, planned overtime hours, and capacity plan version. Supports S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) and capital investment decisions.

attributes.name: capacity_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each capacity plan record in the manufacturing domain. Primary key for the capacity_plan data product.

attributes.name: bottleneck_work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center identified as the capacity bottleneck constraining overall line throughput during this planning period. Used to prioritize capacity improvement investments and focus S&OP constraint management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Bottleneck Work Center (CM21); Theory of Constraints; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: budget_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget_plan. Business justification: Capacity plans drive headcount and capital budgets; linking capacity_plan to budget_plan enables integrated S&OP-to-financial-plan alignment. Automotive OEMs reconcile capacity plans with financial bu

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Capacity plans are time-bounded by fiscal periods for quarterly and annual planning cycles. Automotive OEMs align capacity utilization reporting to fiscal periods for integrated financial-operational

attributes.name: fleet_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.fleet_contract. Business justification: Fleet contracts with large committed volumes are primary inputs to capacity planning. Automotive capacity planners must know which fleet contracts are driving capacity requirements to justify headcoun

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: Capacity plans are built per vehicle model to determine line investment, headcount, and takt time requirements. S&OP and capital expenditure approval processes require capacity plans linked to specifi

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant for which this capacity plan is defined. Links to the manufacturing.plant master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center / Plant; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line (e.g., final assembly line, body shop line, paint line) within the plant for which capacity is being planned. Links to the manufacturing.work_center or production line master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Line; Apriso/Dassault MES — Line Configuration

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shift pattern (e.g., 1-shift, 2-shift, 3-shift) applied in this capacity plan. Shift pattern determines available production hours and directly impacts rated capacity calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Definition; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Capacity planning aligns plant capacity with each vehicle program; capacity_plan needs vehicle_program reference.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Capacity expansion plans requiring CAPEX investment are linked to WBS elements for investment program controlling. capacity_plan.capex_amount is a plain attribute indicating CAPEX relevance; the WBS F

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the capacity plan was formally approved by the designated authority. Marks the transition from 'submitted' to 'approved' status in the S&OP governance process.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 5.3; SAP S/4HANA PP — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the S&OP or manufacturing leadership authority who approved this capacity plan. Required for audit trail and governance compliance under IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 5.3 — Organizational Roles; SAP S/4HANA PP — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: available_hours
attributes.description: Total scheduled production hours available in the planning period after accounting for planned downtime, shift breaks, and scheduled maintenance. Used in conjunction with rated_capacity_jph to compute rated capacity in units.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Available Capacity; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: bottleneck_constraint_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the primary capacity constraint at the bottleneck work center (e.g., 'Paint oven cycle time limits throughput to 58 JPH', 'Robotic welding cell maintenance window reduces available hours'). Supports root cause analysis and CapEx justification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning Notes; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: capacity_gap_units
attributes.description: Difference between planned_production_units and demonstrated_capacity_units, representing the capacity shortfall or surplus for the planning period. Positive value indicates a capacity gap requiring corrective action (overtime, additional shifts, CapEx); negative value indicates surplus capacity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Leveling; S&OP Process; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: capacity_plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capacity planning methodology used. 'rough_cut' (RCCP — Rough Cut Capacity Planning) for high-level S&OP; 'detailed' for work-center-level CRP (Capacity Requirements Planning); 'constraint_based' for Theory of Constraints analysis; 'what_if' for scenario planning and CapEx evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — RCCP/CRP; APICS CPIM Body of Knowledge

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Planned capacity utilization rate expressed as a percentage, calculated as (planned_production_units / rated_capacity_units) × 100. Drives S&OP decisions on overtime, additional shifts, and capital investment. Target thresholds are typically 85–95% for automotive assembly.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Utilization; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; S&OP Best Practice

attributes.name: capex_amount
attributes.description: Estimated capital expenditure amount required to address the capacity gap identified in this plan. Expressed in the plant's operating currency. Used for CapEx budget submissions and investment approval processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Investment Management; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: capex_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capacity plan identifies a requirement for capital investment (CapEx) to close a capacity gap (e.g., new tooling, additional robots, facility expansion). Triggers CapEx approval workflow in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — CapEx Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: changeover_hours
attributes.description: Hours allocated for model changeovers, tooling changes, and line reconfigurations during the planning period. Relevant for mixed-model assembly lines producing multiple vehicle variants (e.g., ICE and BEV on the same line).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Setup Time; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this capacity plan record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this capacity plan record (e.g., USD, EUR, MXN, CNY). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-plant, multi-currency manufacturing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Configuration

attributes.name: daily_production_target
attributes.description: Planned number of vehicles to be produced per working day during the planning period, derived from planned_production_units / working_days. Used for daily MES scheduling and shift-level production targets.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Daily Production Target; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: demonstrated_capacity_units
attributes.description: Actual production output achieved in a comparable prior period, used as the realistic baseline for capacity planning. Reflects real-world constraints such as quality losses, minor stoppages, and changeovers. Key input to APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) capacity studies.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.4.1 — PPAP Capacity Study; APQP Reference Manual

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: Planned End of Production (EOP) date for the vehicle model or program covered by this capacity plan. Marks the milestone when production of the model is scheduled to cease. Used for capacity wind-down planning and asset redeployment decisions.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Program Milestones; APQP Reference Manual; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year (FY) to which this capacity plan belongs, used for CapEx (Capital Expenditure) alignment, budget planning, and financial reporting. Format: FY followed by 4-digit year (e.g., FY2025).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Fiscal Year; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: headcount_required
attributes.description: Total direct labor headcount required to execute the planned production volume during the planning period. Used for workforce planning, hiring decisions, and labor cost budgeting in SuccessFactors and SAP CO.
attributes.references: SuccessFactors — Workforce Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO — Labor Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.2

attributes.name: is_bottleneck_constrained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capacity plan is constrained by a bottleneck work center that limits overall line throughput below the planned production target. When True, the bottleneck_work_center_id and bottleneck_constraint_description fields are populated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Bottleneck Scheduling; Theory of Constraints; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Automotive model year (MY) for which this capacity plan is prepared. Capacity plans are typically aligned to MY production programs, SOP (Start of Production), and EOP (End of Production) milestones.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; NHTSA MY Designation

attributes.name: number_of_shifts
attributes.description: Number of production shifts planned per working day for this capacity plan (e.g., 1, 2, or 3 shifts). Directly determines available production hours and total capacity for the planning period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Model; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the planning period covered by this capacity plan record. Together with plan_start_date, defines the planning window for capacity supply and demand balancing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the capacity plan record, used in S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) communications, SAP PP capacity planning transactions (CM01/CM21), and cross-functional reporting. Format: CP-{PLANT}-{YEAR}-{MONTH}-{SEQ}.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01); IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the planning period covered by this capacity plan record. Used to align capacity supply with demand signals from S&OP and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) runs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capacity plan record. 'draft' indicates work-in-progress; 'submitted' indicates pending approval; 'approved' indicates sign-off by S&OP leadership; 'active' indicates the operative plan driving production scheduling; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'archived' indicates historical record.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the capacity plan, enabling management of multiple planning iterations (e.g., v1.0, v2.0) within the same planning period. Supports S&OP cycle versioning and plan-over-plan variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: planned_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total planned downtime hours for the production line during the planning period, including scheduled maintenance, tooling changeovers, model changeovers, and planned shutdowns. Reduces available production hours from the theoretical maximum.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM — Maintenance Planning; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: planned_maintenance_hours
attributes.description: Subset of planned downtime hours specifically allocated to preventive and predictive maintenance activities on production equipment. Tracked separately from changeover downtime for maintenance KPI reporting and SAP PM integration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM — Preventive Maintenance; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: planned_overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours planned for the production line during the planning period to meet production targets beyond standard shift capacity. Feeds into workforce cost planning and labor budget in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Capacity Planning; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: planned_production_units
attributes.description: Number of vehicles planned for production in the planning period as agreed in the S&OP process. Represents the demand signal that capacity must satisfy. Compared against rated and demonstrated capacity to identify gaps.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; S&OP Process

attributes.name: planning_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the capacity planning horizon for this record. 'weekly' supports short-term MES scheduling; 'monthly' supports S&OP cycles; 'quarterly' and 'annual' support CapEx and strategic workforce planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning Horizon; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: planning_scenario
attributes.description: Demand scenario underpinning this capacity plan. 'base' reflects the consensus S&OP forecast; 'optimistic' reflects upside demand; 'pessimistic' reflects downside risk; 'stretch' reflects maximum achievable output. Enables scenario comparison for executive decision-making.
attributes.references: S&OP Best Practice; SAP S/4HANA PP — Planning Scenario

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology type planned for production in this capacity plan. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine; HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle; PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle; BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle; FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Impacts tooling, line configuration, and capacity requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; EPA Emissions Standards; CAFE Regulations

attributes.name: rated_capacity_jph
attributes.description: Theoretical maximum production rate expressed in Jobs Per Hour (JPH) for the production line under ideal conditions. Derived from takt time and line design specifications. Used as the baseline for capacity utilization calculations in S&OP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Definition; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; SAE J3061

attributes.name: rated_capacity_units
attributes.description: Theoretical maximum number of vehicles that can be produced in the planning period, calculated as rated_capacity_jph × available_hours. Represents the upper bound of production capacity for S&OP and CapEx planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01); IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: sap_capacity_plan_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this capacity plan record in SAP S/4HANA PP (Production Planning) module, used for data lineage traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01/CM21); Data Lineage Best Practice

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: Planned Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle model or program covered by this capacity plan. Marks the milestone when full-rate production is scheduled to begin. Critical for capacity ramp-up planning and APQP milestone tracking.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Program Milestones; APQP Reference Manual; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Planned takt time in seconds for the production line during this planning period, representing the rate at which vehicles must be produced to meet customer demand. Takt time = available production time / planned production units. Core metric in JIS (Just-in-Sequence) and line balancing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center Takt Time; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this capacity plan record was last modified. Tracks plan revisions through the S&OP cycle and supports change management auditing.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: working_days
attributes.description: Number of scheduled working days in the planning period after excluding weekends, public holidays, and planned plant shutdowns. Used to compute daily production targets and available hours.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Factory Calendar; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

products.name: production_variant
products.description: Reference master defining the valid production variants (option combinations) that can be built on a specific production line for a given model year. Captures variant code, model, MY, powertrain type (ICE, HEV, PHEV, BEV), body style, trim level, market destination, and line compatibility flags. Supports build sequence feasibility validation and JIS sequencing rules. Distinct from the commercial product catalog — this is the manufacturing-feasible variant definition.
products.reference: Apriso MES Variant Configuration / SAP PP Configuration

attributes.name: production_variant_id
attributes.description: Primary key for production_variant

attributes.name: apqp_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.apqp_plan. Business justification: Each production variant (market-specific vehicle configuration) has an APQP plan governing its launch quality gates. APQP plans are variant-specific per IATF 16949 APQP requirements; ppap_status on pr

attributes.name: control_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.control_plan. Business justification: Each production variant is governed by a variant-specific control plan (different markets/configurations have different quality controls). PPAP approval requires a control plan per variant. ppap_statu

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Each production variant has a standard cost tracked against a cost center for product costing and variant-level profitability analysis. Automotive OEMs assign cost centers to production variants to en

attributes.name: ecu_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.ecu_specification. Business justification: Each production variant requires a specific ECU specification governing software version, calibration dataset, and OTA capability for end-of-line programming and homologation. Manufacturing and softwa

attributes.name: homologation_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.homologation_record. Business justification: Variant definitions are approved via homologation; linking ensures variant builds only when approved.

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: Variant Definition Process links each variant to its vehicle model for configuration management and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: model_year_program_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vehicle Model Year Program Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vehicle_model_year_program. Business justification: Production variants are scoped to model year programs — SOP/EOP dates, regulatory variants, and PPAP status are all model-year-program-specific. Manufacturing variant lifecycle management requires thi

attributes.name: msrp_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.msrp_schedule. Business justification: Production variant-to-MSRP alignment is required for margin analysis and launch readiness: manufacturers validate that every production variant has an active published MSRP schedule before SOP. This l

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this production variant is authorized to be built. Determines line compatibility, tooling availability, and regulatory homologation scope.

attributes.name: powertrain_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.powertrain_spec. Business justification: Each production variant is governed by a specific engineering powertrain_spec defining assembly parameters, emissions compliance, and PPAP requirements. Manufacturing engineers and APQP teams require

attributes.name: powertrain_variant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.powertrain_variant. Business justification: Manufacturing production variants must trace to certified vehicle powertrain_variants for emissions compliance validation, PPAP approval, and regulatory homologation. Production engineers verify each

attributes.name: price_condition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_price_condition. Business justification: Variant-level pricing drives dealer invoice amounts and MSRP in automotive billing. Each production variant (trim, powertrain, options) maps to specific SAP SD price conditions used to generate the ve

attributes.name: production_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing BOM (Bill of Materials) version applicable to this production variant. Links to the BOM master in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or SAP MM (Materials Management) to resolve component lists for production planning and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) execution.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3.5 — Design and Development Outputs; SAP MM BOM Management

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line within the plant on which this variant is authorized to be assembled. Drives JIS (Just-in-Sequence) feasibility validation and takt time allocation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5 — Production and Service Provision

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing routing (operation sequence) applicable to this production variant in SAP PP (Production Planning). Defines the sequence of work centers, operations, and standard times required to build this variant from stamping through final assembly.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production; SAP PP Routing

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sku_master. Business justification: Each production variant maps to a finished-goods SKU for inventory valuation, dealer stock management, and SAP material master integration. sap_material_number is a denormalized SKU reference that thi

attributes.name: trim_level_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vehicle_trim_level. Business justification: Production variants are built to specific trim levels, driving component allocation, labor standards, and JIS sequencing. Manufacturing scheduling systems require the trim_level FK to determine correc

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Variants are defined under a vehicle program; variant management reports require vehicle_program_id.

attributes.name: adas_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Automation Level
attributes.description: SAE J3016 automation level of the ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) suite fitted to this production variant: L0 (no automation), L1 (driver assistance), L2 (partial automation), L2_PLUS (enhanced partial automation), L3 (conditional automation). Drives ECU (Electronic Control Unit) software configuration, OTA (Over-the-Air Update) eligibility, and UNECE UN R157 regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAE J3016 — Taxonomy of Driving Automation; UNECE UN R157 — ALKS; NHTSA AV Policy

attributes.name: assembly_complexity_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (1–10) representing the relative assembly complexity of this production variant compared to the base variant on the same production line. Higher scores indicate more assembly operations, longer cycle times, or specialized tooling requirements. Used for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) sequencing optimization to balance line loading and avoid consecutive high-complexity builds.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1; SAE J4000 — Lean Manufacturing Assessment

attributes.name: battery_capacity_kwh
attributes.description: Usable battery pack capacity in kilowatt-hours (kWh) for BEV, PHEV, and HEV variants. Null for pure ICE variants. Drives assembly sequencing for battery marriage station, WLTP (Worldwide Harmonised Light Vehicles Test Procedure) range certification, and EPA electric range labelling.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 600 — Fuel Economy; WLTP Regulation (EU) 2017/1151; SAE J1634

attributes.name: body_style_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the vehicle body configuration for this production variant (e.g., SEDAN, SUV, TRUCK, COUPE, HATCHBACK, MINIVAN). Determines stamping die sets, body shop tooling, and paint booth configuration requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SEDAN|SUV|TRUCK|COUPE|HATCHBACK|MINIVAN|CONVERTIBLE|WAGON|VAN|CROSSOVER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAE J1100 — Vehicle Dimensions; ISO 3833 — Road Vehicles Types

attributes.name: co2_emission_g_per_km
attributes.description: Certified CO2 tailpipe emission in grams per kilometre (g/km) under WLTP or NEDC test cycle for this production variant. Used for EU CO2 fleet average compliance (Regulation (EU) 2019/631), CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) calculations, and vehicle taxation band classification in destination markets.
attributes.references: EU Regulation 2019/631 — CO2 Standards for Cars; EPA 40 CFR Part 86; CARB Title 13

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production variant record was first created in the manufacturing master data system. Provides audit trail for data governance and IATF 16949 documented information control requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: destination_market_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the primary market for which this production variant is homologated and destined (e.g., 'USA', 'DEU', 'JPN'). Governs regulatory compliance requirements (NHTSA FMVSS, Euro NCAP, UNECE), emission standards, and right-hand vs left-hand drive configuration.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; NHTSA FMVSS; UNECE Vehicle Regulations; Euro NCAP

attributes.name: drive_configuration
attributes.description: Drivetrain configuration specifying which axles receive motive power: FWD (Front-Wheel Drive), RWD (Rear-Wheel Drive), AWD (All-Wheel Drive), or 4WD (Four-Wheel Drive). Determines chassis assembly routing, driveshaft fitment, and NVH (Noise Vibration Harshness) validation requirements.

attributes.name: engine_displacement_cc
attributes.description: Total engine displacement in cubic centimetres (cc) for ICE (Internal Combustion Engine) and HEV/PHEV variants. Null for BEV and FCEV variants. Used for regulatory classification under EPA, CARB, and UNECE emissions standards, and for CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) fleet averaging calculations.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86; UNECE Regulation No. 83 — Emissions

attributes.name: engineering_change_level
attributes.description: Current engineering change revision level for this production variant as managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or PTC Windchill (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C1', 'REV3'). Tracks design maturity and ensures the correct BOM (Bill of Materials) version is applied during production. Incremented upon each approved engineering change notice (ECN).
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3.6 — Design and Development Changes; Siemens Teamcenter PLM ECM

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: Date on which this production variant is scheduled to cease production (EOP — End of Production). Drives last-order scheduling, tooling decommissioning planning, and spare parts provisioning for after-sales service obligations.
attributes.references: APQP Phase 5 — Feedback, Assessment and Corrective Action; IATF 16949

attributes.name: fuel_economy_mpg
attributes.description: EPA-certified combined fuel economy in miles per gallon (MPG) for ICE, HEV, and PHEV variants in NAFTA markets. Null for BEV/FCEV variants. Used for CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) fleet compliance reporting to EPA and consumer window sticker labelling under 49 CFR Part 575.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 600 — Fuel Economy; CAFE Standards 49 CFR Part 533; NHTSA

attributes.name: gross_vehicle_weight_kg
attributes.description: Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) in kilograms for this production variant. Used for regulatory classification under DOT FMVSS, UNECE weight regulations, and CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) fleet averaging. Also drives chassis assembly torque specifications and suspension tuning parameters.
attributes.references: NHTSA FMVSS 120; UNECE Regulation No. 13 — Braking; DOT 49 CFR Part 571

attributes.name: hand_of_drive
attributes.description: Steering wheel position for this production variant: LHD (Left-Hand Drive) for markets such as USA, Germany; RHD (Right-Hand Drive) for markets such as UK, Japan, Australia. Determines instrument panel assembly variant, steering column routing, and body shop tooling configuration.
attributes.references: UNECE Regulation No. 48 — Installation of Lighting; ISO 4130

attributes.name: homologation_status
attributes.description: Regulatory type-approval and homologation status for this production variant in the target destination market: PENDING (application submitted), CERTIFIED (full approval granted), CONDITIONAL (provisional approval with conditions), EXPIRED (certification lapsed), NOT_REQUIRED. Governs whether the variant can be legally sold in the destination market.
attributes.references: UNECE WP.29 — Type Approval; NHTSA FMVSS Certification; Euro NCAP; DOT 49 CFR Part 567

attributes.name: is_ckd_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production variant can be produced as a CKD (Completely Knocked Down) kit for assembly at an overseas plant (True = CKD eligible). Drives export documentation, customs tariff classification, and overseas plant BOM (Bill of Materials) configuration in SAP MM.
attributes.references: WTO Customs Valuation Agreement; SAP MM CKD Processing; IATF 16949

attributes.name: is_jis_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production variant is eligible for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) supplier call-off sequencing (True = JIS eligible). JIS-eligible variants require sequenced component delivery synchronized to the build sequence, impacting supplier logistics contracts and MES call-off trigger configuration.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.4 — Control of Externally Provided Processes; SAE J4000

attributes.name: is_line_compatible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production variant has been validated as feasible for assembly on the assigned production line (True = compatible, False = not compatible). Serves as the primary gate flag in MES (Manufacturing Execution System) build sequence feasibility validation and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) call-off authorization.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: is_ota_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production variant supports OTA (Over-the-Air) software updates for ECU (Electronic Control Unit) and infotainment systems (True = OTA capable). Drives connected vehicle service provisioning in Geotab/Bosch IoT platform and UNECE UN R156 software update regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: UNECE UN R156 — Software Update Processes; NHTSA Cybersecurity Best Practices; SAE J3101

attributes.name: max_consecutive_builds
attributes.description: Maximum number of consecutive units of this production variant that can be scheduled back-to-back in the build sequence without violating line balancing or ergonomic constraints. Enforced by MES (Manufacturing Execution System) JIS (Just-in-Sequence) sequencing rules to prevent operator fatigue and tooling overload.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production; Apriso/Dassault MES Sequencing Rules

attributes.name: mes_variant_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier for this production variant in the Apriso/Dassault MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Used for real-time build sequence call-off, WIP (Work in Progress) tracking, and quality gate routing on the shop floor.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Four-digit model year (MY) for which this production variant is defined and authorized. Governs BOM (Bill of Materials) version applicability, regulatory homologation, and CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) compliance grouping. Range: 2000–2040.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 — VIN Requirements; EPA CAFE Standards

attributes.name: ncap_safety_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Car Assessment Programme (NCAP) Safety Rating
attributes.description: Overall NCAP (New Car Assessment Programme) safety star rating achieved by this production variant (1 to 5 stars, or NOT_RATED if not yet assessed). Applicable to Euro NCAP, NHTSA NCAP, or ANCAP depending on destination market. Used for regulatory compliance reporting and marketing communications.
attributes.references: Euro NCAP Assessment Protocol; NHTSA 5-Star Safety Ratings Program; ANCAP

attributes.name: option_package_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the bundled option package associated with this production variant (e.g., 'TECH_PKG', 'SAFETY_PKG', 'LUXURY_PKG'). Maps to a specific set of BOM (Bill of Materials) components and assembly operations in Siemens Teamcenter PLM and SAP PP configurable material management.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Variant Configuration; SAP PP — Configurable Materials (KMAT)

attributes.name: paint_process_type
attributes.description: Classification of the paint application process required for this production variant: STANDARD (solid colour), METALLIC, PEARL, MATTE, or TWO_TONE. Determines paint booth routing, cure cycle parameters, and paint material BOM (Bill of Materials) components in the body shop and paint shop assembly stages.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production; ISO 12647 — Colour Standards

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle powertrain technology for this variant: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives assembly process routing, tooling requirements, and EPA/CARB emissions compliance classification.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86 — Emissions Standards; CARB Title 13; SAE J1715

attributes.name: ppap_status
attributes.description: Current PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) approval status for this production variant. PPAP approval is a mandatory quality gate before SOP (Start of Production) under IATF 16949. Status values: NOT_REQUIRED, PENDING, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED. Drives production release authorization in MES.
attributes.references: AIAG PPAP 4th Edition; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3.4 — Design and Development Controls

attributes.name: regulatory_region
attributes.description: Regulatory compliance region grouping for this production variant, used to apply the correct homologation ruleset: NAFTA (North America), EU (European Union), APAC (Asia-Pacific), LATAM (Latin America), MEA (Middle East & Africa), CHINA. Determines applicable NCAP (New Car Assessment Programme) standards, emissions regulations, and safety certification requirements.
attributes.references: UNECE WP.29 — World Forum for Harmonization of Vehicle Regulations; NHTSA; Euro NCAP

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: Date on which this production variant is authorized to enter volume production (SOP — Start of Production). Used for production planning gate reviews, PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) milestone tracking, and supplier readiness confirmation.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Phase 4 — Product and Process Validation; IATF 16949

attributes.name: standard_build_hours
attributes.description: Standard labor hours required to complete the full assembly of this production variant from stamping through final assembly and PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection). Used for production cost standard setting, workforce planning, and SAP CO (Controlling) cost object calculation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1; SAP CO Standard Cost Estimation

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Allocated takt time in seconds for building this production variant on the assigned production line. Represents the available production time divided by customer demand rate. Used for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) scheduling, capacity planning, and bottleneck identification in MES (Manufacturing Execution System).
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production; SAE J4000 — Lean Manufacturing

attributes.name: teamcenter_variant_code
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier for this production variant in Siemens Teamcenter PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) variant configuration module. Enables traceability between the manufacturing master data record and the engineering variant definition in the PLM system of record.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Variant Configuration; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Type of transmission fitted in this production variant: AUTOMATIC (conventional automatic), MANUAL (manual gearbox), CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission), DCT (Dual-Clutch Transmission), or SINGLE_SPEED (for BEV/FCEV). Drives assembly routing to the correct powertrain marriage station and torque tooling specification.
attributes.references: SAE J1297 — Automatic Transmission Functions; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production variant record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and for engineering change audit trail compliance under IATF 16949 documented information control.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: v2x_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production variant is equipped with V2X (Vehicle-to-Everything) communication hardware (True = V2X capable). Drives telematics module assembly sequencing, spectrum licensing compliance, and connected mobility service activation in Geotab/Bosch IoT platform.
attributes.references: SAE J2945 — V2X Communications; ETSI ITS Standards; FCC 47 CFR Part 95

attributes.name: variant_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this production variant within the manufacturing system. Used as the primary business key in MES (Manufacturing Execution System), PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), and SAP PP (Production Planning) for variant identification and cross-system referencing. Sourced from Siemens Teamcenter PLM variant configuration.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3 — Design and Development; SAP PP Variant Configuration

attributes.name: variant_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the production variant (e.g., 'F-Series SuperCrew 4x4 BEV Long Range'). Used in build sequence planning, shop floor documentation, and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) scheduling displays.

attributes.name: variant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production variant within the manufacturing master data: ACTIVE (currently buildable), PLANNED (approved for future SOP), INACTIVE (not currently scheduled), DISCONTINUED (past EOP), ON_HOLD (temporarily suspended pending engineering change or regulatory review). Drives MES build feasibility checks.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3 — Design and Development; SAP PP Material Status

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) internal model code identifying the vehicle platform or nameplate (e.g., 'F150', 'RAV4', 'MODEL3'). Links the production variant to the vehicle program in PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) and SAP MM (Materials Management).
attributes.references: SAE J1100 — Vehicle Dimensions; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: wltp_range_km
attributes.business_glossary_term: Worldwide Harmonised Light Vehicles Test Procedure (WLTP) Range (km)
attributes.description: Official WLTP (Worldwide Harmonised Light Vehicles Test Procedure) certified driving range in kilometres for BEV and PHEV variants. Null for ICE and HEV variants. Used for EU regulatory labelling, EPA range certification cross-reference, and consumer-facing range claims.
attributes.references: WLTP Regulation (EU) 2017/1151; EPA 40 CFR Part 600 — Fuel Economy Labelling

products.name: routing_operation
products.description: This association product represents the operational step between routing and work_center. It captures the assignment of a specific work center to a specific operation within a manufacturing routing. Each record links one routing to one work_center with operation-specific parameters that exist only in the context of this routing-work center assignment, such as operation sequence, cycle times, and setup requirements.. Existence Justification: In automotive manufacturing, a routing defines the complete manufacturing process for a product family, consisting of multiple sequential operations, each performed at a specific work center. One routing contains many operations across different work centers (e.g., stamping → welding → painting → assembly), and one work center participates in many different routings (e.g., a robotic welding station is used in SUV routing, truck routing, and sedan routing). The routing_operation is a standard business entity in SAP PP and MES systems, representing the assignment of a work center to a specific step in a routing with operation-specific parameters.
