attributes.name: order_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that placed this order. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: order_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that placed this order. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: order_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer for whom this order is placed. Populated for retail (customer-specific) orders; null for stock orders.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_order. Business justification: Required for Dealer Order Fulfillment report linking each dealer order to the specific production order that will build the vehicle.

attributes.name: production_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.plant. Business justification: Dealer orders are fulfilled by a specific manufacturing plant; OTD (on-time delivery) tracking and logistics coordination require knowing the source plant. production_plant_code is a denormalized plan

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Dealer orders represent committed future revenue requiring profit center assignment for sales pipeline reporting, order bank valuation, forecast accuracy analysis, and revenue recognition planning in

attributes.name: vehicle_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.vehicle_order. Business justification: Dealer order reconciliation report matches each dealer purchase order to the OEM vehicle order that fulfills it.

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Dealer orders are placed for specific vehicle programs. OEM order management, production scheduling, and homologation variant validation require linking dealer orders to the engineering vehicle_progra

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Dealer order processing must associate each order with the specific VIN to enable production tracking and post‑sale service.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual date the vehicle was physically delivered to the dealership. Used to calculate On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance against the confirmed delivery date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS; OTD KPI Framework

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: The actual date the vehicle departed the production plant or port for transit to the dealership. Used to measure logistics performance and update OTD tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; DOT Transportation Regulations

attributes.name: allocation_pool_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the vehicle allocation pool or program from which this order is fulfilled (e.g., regional allocation, fleet pool, dealer stock pool). Governs allocation rules and constraints.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason for order cancellation (e.g., customer withdrawal, dealer over-allocation, duplicate order). Populated only when order_status is cancelled.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The OEM-confirmed delivery date communicated back to the dealer after production scheduling. May differ from the requested delivery date.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the dealer order record was first created in the system. Audit trail field conforming to IATF 16949 data traceability requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this order (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Enables multi-currency reporting across dealer networks in different markets.

attributes.name: days_late
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the actual delivery date exceeded the confirmed delivery date. Zero or negative values indicate on-time or early delivery. Used for OTD variance analysis and dealer penalty calculations.

attributes.name: dealer_invoice_amount
attributes.description: The wholesale invoice price charged by the OEM to the dealer for this vehicle order. Represents the net amount the dealer pays before any holdback or incentive adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; FTC Dealer Pricing Regulations

attributes.name: dms_order_number
attributes.description: Order reference number assigned by the CDK Global Dealer Management System at the dealership level. Enables reconciliation between OEM and dealer systems.

attributes.name: estimated_ship_date
attributes.description: The estimated date the vehicle is expected to depart the production plant or port for transit to the dealership. Used for logistics planning and dealer communication.

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason an order has been placed on hold, such as parts shortage, regulatory hold, credit hold, or customer change request. Null when order is not on hold.

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Total OEM incentive or discount amount applied to this order, including dealer cash, consumer cash, and program incentives. Reduces the effective dealer cost.

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the market where the vehicle will be sold. Determines applicable regulatory standards (NHTSA, EPA, CARB, Euro NCAP, UNECE), homologation requirements, and pricing.

attributes.name: msrp_amount
attributes.description: The Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) for the fully configured vehicle as ordered, in the base currency. Represents the gross base amount before dealer adjustments, incentives, or taxes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; FTC Pricing Regulations

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions associated with the order, entered by the dealer or OEM order management team. May include customer preferences, special handling requirements, or escalation notes.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the dealer submitted the order to the OEM. This is the principal business event date for the order transaction.

attributes.name: order_source
attributes.description: The channel or system through which the dealer order was submitted to the OEM: dealer portal, CDK Global DMS integration, EDI transmission, manual entry, or API.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the dealer order tracking progression from submission through delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|confirmed|scheduled|produced|shipped|delivered|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the order indicating whether it is a dealer stock replenishment order, a retail customer-specific order, a demonstration vehicle order, a fleet order, or a courtesy vehicle order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: otd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle was delivered on or before the confirmed delivery date. True = delivered on time; False = delivered late. Core metric for OTD performance reporting and dealer satisfaction.

attributes.name: pdi_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) was completed at the dealership. Null if PDI has not yet been performed.

attributes.name: pdi_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) is required before the vehicle is handed over to the customer. True = PDI mandatory; False = PDI not required.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; IATF 16949 PDI Standards

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Priority classification assigned to the order for production scheduling and allocation purposes. Higher priority orders are scheduled earlier in the production sequence.

attributes.name: production_week
attributes.description: ISO 8601 production week (e.g., 2025-W23) in which the vehicle is scheduled to be built. Used for production scheduling, capacity planning, and OTD tracking.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the dealer has requested the vehicle to be delivered to the dealership. Used for On-Time Delivery (OTD) target setting and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; OTD KPI Framework

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: OEM sales region code associated with the ordering dealer. Used for regional sales performance reporting, allocation management, and incentive program eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: sap_sales_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known SAP SD sales order number assigned by the OEM ERP system upon order confirmation. Used for cross-system traceability between the lakehouse and SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: The logistics mode used to transport the vehicle from the production plant to the dealership: rail, truck (auto carrier), ocean vessel, or a combination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Shipping; DOT Transportation Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the dealer order record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks lakehouse.

products.name: retail_sale
products.description: Records the retail sale of a new or used vehicle by a dealership to an end customer. Captures VIN, sale date, sale price, MSRP, discount amount, trade-in details, financing type (cash, retail finance, lease), F&I products sold, salesperson, and deal status. Sourced from CDK Global DMS F&I module. SSOT for dealer-level vehicle sales transactions.
products.reference: CDK Global DMS F&I Deal Jacket

attributes.name: retail_sale_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each retail vehicle sale transaction record in the dealer domain. Primary key for the retail_sale data product.

attributes.name: dealer_inventory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.dealer_inventory. Business justification: A retail sale sells a specific vehicle from dealer inventory. retail_sale has stock_number (string) but no FK to dealer_inventory. Adding dealer_inventory_id directly links the sale transaction to the

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Retail sale conversion analysis links the final sale back to the originating sales opportunity for win‑loss tracking.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.order. Business justification: A retail sale fulfills a dealer order — the order captures the OEM-to-dealer vehicle order (stock or customer-specific), and the retail_sale records the dealer-to-customer transaction for that vehicle

attributes.name: primary_retail_customer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer (buyer) who purchased the vehicle. Links to the customer master record.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud CRM; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: primary_retail_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that executed the retail sale transaction. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Retail sales are the primary revenue event requiring profit center assignment for actual vs. budget variance analysis, dealer profitability reporting, and contribution margin tracking by sales channel

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Retail sale reporting and warranty registration depend on linking the sold vehicle to its VIN registry entry.

attributes.name: apr
attributes.description: The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) on the retail installment contract as disclosed to the customer under Regulation Z. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0699 for 6.99%). Null for cash and lease deals.
attributes.references: Truth in Lending Act (TILA) Regulation Z; CFPB; CDK Global DMS F&I

attributes.name: back_end_gross
attributes.description: Gross profit earned from F&I products and dealer reserve on the financing (back-end), representing the total F&I department contribution to the deal. Key dealer profitability metric.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; NADA Dealer Financial Profile

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the retail sale record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer ingestion). Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; IATF 16949 Record Retention; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this retail sale record (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Supports multi-market dealer network operations.

attributes.name: deal_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric deal reference number assigned by the CDK Global DMS F&I module at the time the deal is opened. Used for cross-referencing with dealer records, lender submissions, and OEM reporting.

attributes.name: deal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the retail sale deal. 'draft' indicates deal is being structured; 'pending' indicates awaiting lender funding approval; 'funded' indicates lender has funded the deal; 'unwound' indicates a previously funded deal that was reversed; 'cancelled' indicates deal was voided before funding.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; NHTSA Dealer Reporting

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The date the vehicle was physically delivered to the customer following Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI). May differ from sale_date when delivery is deferred. Used for warranty start date determination and OEM retail reporting.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; NHTSA; OEM Warranty Policy

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the vehicle sale, calculated as MSRP minus sale price. Includes dealer discounts, OEM incentive discounts, and employee pricing adjustments. Used for dealer margin analysis and OEM incentive reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; OEM Incentive Program Guidelines

attributes.name: dms_deal_reference
attributes.description: The native deal identifier assigned by the CDK Global DMS F&I module. Used for source system traceability, reconciliation, and integration with downstream OEM reporting and lender portals.

attributes.name: doc_fee
attributes.description: Dealer-charged documentation and processing fee included in the deal. Subject to state-level regulatory caps in many jurisdictions. Disclosed on the buyer's order.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; State DMV Regulations; FTC

attributes.name: down_payment
attributes.description: Cash down payment made by the customer at the time of sale, excluding trade-in allowance. Reduces the amount financed. Used for deal structure analysis and lender submission.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB

attributes.name: fi_product_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross revenue generated from Finance and Insurance (F&I) aftermarket products sold as part of the deal, including extended service contracts, GAP insurance, paint protection, tire and wheel protection, and credit life/disability insurance.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; NADA F&I Guidelines

attributes.name: finance_amount
attributes.description: The total amount financed by the customer under the retail installment contract, including vehicle price, F&I products, taxes, and fees, less down payment and trade-in allowance. Null for cash deals.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; Truth in Lending Act (TILA) Regulation Z; CFPB

attributes.name: financing_type
attributes.description: The method by which the customer is financing the vehicle purchase. 'cash' = outright purchase; 'retail_finance' = retail installment contract through a lender; 'lease' = closed-end consumer lease; 'balloon' = balloon payment retail contract.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB; Truth in Lending Act (TILA); Consumer Leasing Act

attributes.name: fleet_sale
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle was sold as part of a fleet or commercial account transaction rather than a retail consumer sale. Fleet sales are tracked separately for CAFE compliance, OEM fleet incentive programs, and sales mix reporting.
attributes.references: CAFE 49 CFR Part 533; EPA; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: front_end_gross
attributes.description: Gross profit earned on the vehicle sale itself (front-end), calculated as sale price minus dealer invoice cost and pack. Excludes F&I product revenue. Key dealer profitability metric reported in DMS and OEM dealer scorecards.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; NADA Dealer Financial Profile

attributes.name: lender_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution (captive finance company, bank, credit union) that approved and funded the retail installment contract or lease. Null for cash deals. Used for lender mix reporting and dealer reserve analysis.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB Auto Lending

attributes.name: loan_term_months
attributes.description: The contractual term of the retail installment contract expressed in months (e.g., 36, 48, 60, 72, 84). Used for lender mix analysis, payment affordability reporting, and portfolio risk assessment.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB Auto Lending

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The Model Year (MY) of the vehicle sold, as defined by the OEM and NHTSA. Used for CAFE compliance reporting, incentive program eligibility, and sales mix analytics.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; CAFE Reporting; EPA

attributes.name: monthly_payment
attributes.description: The customer's contracted monthly payment amount under the retail installment contract or lease agreement. Used for affordability analysis and customer financial profiling.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; Truth in Lending Act (TILA) Regulation Z

attributes.name: msrp_amount
attributes.description: The Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) of the vehicle as stickered, inclusive of all factory-installed options and destination charges. Expressed in the local currency (USD). Used as the baseline for discount calculation, incentive reporting, and dealer margin analysis.
attributes.references: Monroney Sticker Act (15 U.S.C. § 1231); CDK Global DMS F&I

attributes.name: oem_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Total value of OEM-funded customer incentives applied to the deal, including cash-back rebates, conquest bonuses, loyalty bonuses, and special program pricing. Sourced from OEM incentive program data and reconciled against dealer statements.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Program; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: oem_program_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned program code identifying the specific incentive or sales program under which the vehicle was sold (e.g., employee pricing, conquest, loyalty, fleet, rental). Used for OEM incentive claim submission and program performance reporting.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Program Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: pdi_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) was completed and signed off by the dealer technician prior to vehicle delivery to the customer. PDI completion is required for warranty activation and OEM delivery standards compliance.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Service Module; OEM PDI Standards; IATF 16949

attributes.name: sale_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the retail vehicle sale was consummated — i.e., the date the buyer signed the retail installment contract or cash purchase agreement. This is the principal business event date used for sales reporting, OEM incentive eligibility, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; SAP S/4HANA SD; NHTSA

attributes.name: sale_price
attributes.description: The agreed-upon selling price of the vehicle as negotiated between the dealer and the customer, before trade-in allowance, taxes, and fees. This is the gross capitalized cost for lease deals or the selling price for retail finance and cash deals.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: sales_tax_amount
attributes.description: State and local sales tax assessed on the vehicle sale transaction. Calculated based on the taxable selling price and the applicable jurisdiction tax rate. Used for tax remittance reporting and deal cost reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; State Revenue Authority Requirements

attributes.name: stock_number
attributes.description: Dealer-assigned inventory stock number for the vehicle unit at the time of sale. Used for dealer inventory management and reconciliation with CDK Global DMS inventory records.

attributes.name: trade_in_allowance
attributes.description: The agreed trade-in value credited to the customer for a vehicle traded in as part of the deal. Reduces the amount financed or cash due. Null if no trade-in vehicle was involved in the transaction.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; FTC Used Car Rule

attributes.name: trade_in_payoff_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding loan or lease payoff balance on the customer's trade-in vehicle at the time of the deal. If payoff exceeds trade-in allowance, the difference (negative equity) is typically rolled into the new deal.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB Auto Lending Guidelines

attributes.name: trade_in_vin
attributes.description: The 17-character VIN of the customer's trade-in vehicle, if applicable. Used for used vehicle inventory intake, auction disposition tracking, and trade-in equity analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3779; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the retail sale record was last modified in the data platform, reflecting deal amendments, status changes, or corrections sourced from CDK Global DMS. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; IATF 16949 Record Retention; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: vehicle_condition
attributes.description: Condition classification of the vehicle at point of sale. 'new' indicates a new, untitled vehicle; 'used' indicates a previously titled vehicle; 'certified_pre_owned' indicates a manufacturer-certified pre-owned vehicle meeting OEM CPO program standards.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; OEM CPO Program Standards; FTC Used Car Rule

attributes.name: warranty_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the OEM new vehicle limited warranty period commences, typically aligned with the delivery_date or sale_date per OEM warranty policy. Used for warranty claim eligibility determination.
attributes.references: OEM Warranty Policy; Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act; CDK Global DMS

products.name: dealer_service_appointment
products.description: Scheduled service appointments at a dealership for vehicle maintenance, warranty repair, recall service, or customer-pay work. Tracks appointment date/time, customer, VIN, service type, advisor assigned, estimated duration, appointment status (scheduled, checked-in, in-progress, completed, no-show), and transportation option (loaner, shuttle, wait). Sourced from CDK Global DMS service scheduling module.

attributes.name: dealer_service_appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer_service_appointment data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: aftersales_service_appointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.service_appointment. Business justification: Business process: Dealer DMS schedules service appointments; aftersales processes them. Linking ensures appointment sync for parts, labor, and warranty tracking.

attributes.name: dealership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.dealership. Business justification: Dealer service appointments belong to a dealership; add dealership_id FK to link to dealership and remove redundant dealer_id column.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Service appointment scheduling needs to associate the customer (party) with the appointment for service history and follow‑up.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Service appointment scheduling must reference the specific vehicle VIN to allocate resources and track service history.

products.name: dealer_repair_order
products.description: Detailed repair order (RO) record for each vehicle service event at a dealership. Captures RO number, open/close dates, VIN, mileage-in, complaint/cause/correction (3C), labor operations, technician assignments, parts consumed, warranty vs customer-pay vs internal split, total labor hours, total parts cost, and RO status. Core operational record for dealer service operations sourced from CDK Global DMS.

attributes.name: dealer_repair_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer_repair_order data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: aftersales_repair_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.repair_order. Business justification: Process: Dealer creates a repair order in DMS; it must reference the central aftersales repair order for warranty validation and labor costing.

attributes.name: dealer_service_appointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.dealer_service_appointment. Business justification: A dealer repair order is the operational fulfillment of a service appointment. The dealer_service_appointment is the parent scheduling record; the dealer_repair_order is the child execution record. Th

attributes.name: dealership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.dealership. Business justification: A dealer repair order is performed at a specific dealership. dealer_repair_order currently has no FK to dealership (only to aftersales.aftersales_repair_order, customer.party, and vehicle.vin_registry

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Repair orders must be linked to the owning customer for warranty claim processing and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Repair orders must be tied to the VIN registry to manage warranty repairs and parts usage per vehicle.

products.name: dealer_incentive_claim
products.description: Individual dealer claims submitted against OEM incentive programs. Tracks claim submission date, program, claim period, claimed units or metric, supporting evidence, claim status (submitted, under review, approved, rejected, paid), approved amount, and payment reference. Integrates with SAP FI for payout processing.

attributes.name: dealer_incentive_claim_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each dealer incentive claim record. Primary key for the incentive_claim data product.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.campaign. Business justification: Dealer incentive claims are tied to specific OEM sales campaigns (volume bonuses, conquest programs, model-year-end pushes). Critical for incentive reconciliation, campaign ROI analysis, and dealer pr

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Incentive claims must be matched to fiscal periods for period-end close, accrual reversal in subsequent periods, and accurate quarterly/annual incentive expense recognition in automotive OEM-dealer ac

attributes.name: franchise_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.franchise_agreement. Business justification: Dealer incentive claims are submitted under the terms of a franchise agreement — the franchise agreement defines incentive_program_eligibility_flag, minimum_sales_quota_annual, and performance_review_

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Incentive claims must post to specific GL accounts for accrual accounting, audit trail compliance, and financial statement accuracy. Links claim to chart of accounts for automated posting and reconcil

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: OEM incentive programs are structured by vehicle model line. Linking dealer_incentive_claim to vehicle.model enables automated eligibility validation, supports OEM financial reconciliation reporting b

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment. Business justification: Approved incentive claims result in payments to dealers. Core OEM-to-dealer financial settlement - tracks which payment settled each claim for reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: primary_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer submitting this incentive claim. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Dealer incentive claims are validated against specific vehicle programs (model year, powertrain type, vehicle line). OEM incentive program administration requires linking claims to vehicle_program for

attributes.name: accrual_posted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial accrual has been posted in SAP FI for this incentive claim liability. True = accrual posted; False = accrual not yet posted. Used for period-end financial close management and EBITDA reporting accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP FI Accrual Management; IFRS 15; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary adjustment applied by the OEM during claim review, representing the difference between claimed_amount and approved_amount. A negative value indicates a reduction; positive indicates an upward correction. Supports audit trail and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP FI Adjustment Posting; OEM Dealer Audit Policy

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the approved_amount differs from the claimed_amount. Populated by the OEM reviewer when an adjustment is applied. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ineligible_units|duplicate_claim|missing_evidence|calculation_error|program_cap_exceeded|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Audit Policy; SAP FI Reason Codes

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount approved by the OEM after review and validation of the dealer's claim. May differ from claimed_amount due to adjustments, disallowed units, or partial approvals. This is the amount committed for payment processing in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Run; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: approved_units
attributes.description: Number of vehicle units or qualifying transactions validated and approved by the OEM reviewer. May be less than claimed_units if some units are found ineligible during audit. Used to calculate the approved_amount for volume-based programs.
attributes.references: OEM Volume Incentive Program Rules; SAP SD Sales Audit

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable unique claim reference number assigned at submission. Used by dealers and OEM finance teams to track and reference the claim across systems including CDK Global DMS and SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Numbering; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: claim_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance or sales period covered by this incentive claim. Defines the close of the measurement window. Together with claim_period_start_date, establishes the claim period boundary for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Program Terms; SAP SD Rebate Settlement

attributes.name: claim_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance or sales period covered by this incentive claim. Defines the beginning of the measurement window for which the dealer is claiming the incentive.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Program Terms; SAP SD Rebate Settlement

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the incentive claim through the OEM review and payment lifecycle. Valid states: submitted (initial dealer submission), under_review (OEM audit in progress), approved (claim validated and approved for payment), rejected (claim denied), paid (payment disbursed via SAP FI), cancelled (withdrawn by dealer or voided by OEM).
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Processing; IATF 16949 Dealer Compliance

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Category of incentive claim being submitted, reflecting the nature of the OEM incentive program. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: volume_bonus|retail_incentive|floor_plan|marketing_support|customer_satisfaction|parts_sales|service_absorption — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Types; OEM Dealer Incentive Policy

attributes.name: claimed_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount claimed by the dealer against the incentive program, expressed in the transaction currency. This is the dealer-submitted figure prior to OEM review and approval. Used for financial accrual and liability estimation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Accounts Payable; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: claimed_metric_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the claimed_metric_value field, indicating how the performance metric is expressed (e.g., units for vehicle count, percentage for service absorption rate, score for NPS/CSI, amount for revenue-based claims).

attributes.name: claimed_metric_value
attributes.description: The quantitative performance metric value being claimed by the dealer, applicable for non-unit-based programs such as customer satisfaction scores (NPS), service absorption rates, or parts sales amounts. Complements claimed_units for metric-driven incentive types.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Scorecard; NPS (Net Promoter Score) Methodology

attributes.name: claimed_units
attributes.description: Number of vehicle units or qualifying transactions the dealer is claiming against the incentive program for the claim period. Applicable for volume-based incentive programs such as volume bonus and retail incentive programs.
attributes.references: OEM Volume Incentive Program Rules; SAP SD Sales Statistics

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center code to which the incentive payout is charged. Used for internal cost allocation and management accounting of dealer incentive expenditure by brand, region, or program type.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Accounting; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the market in which the dealer operates and the claim is filed. Supports multi-market OEM operations and ensures correct regulatory and tax treatment of incentive payouts.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SAP FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the incentive claim record was first created in the system. Represents the audit creation time (distinct from submission_date which is the business event date). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP FI Document Creation; IATF 16949 Records Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this claim (claimed_amount, approved_amount, paid_amount). Supports multi-currency dealer networks operating in different markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: dealer_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the dealer representative responsible for this claim. Used for claim status notifications, evidence requests, and dispute correspondence. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR and applicable privacy regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CDK Global DMS; OEM Dealer Communication Policy

attributes.name: dealer_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the dealer-side representative who submitted or is responsible for this incentive claim. Used for communication, follow-up, and audit correspondence between OEM and dealer.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Dealer Contacts; OEM Dealer Agreement

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dealer formally raised a dispute against the OEM's claim decision. Populated only when dispute_flag is True. Used to track dispute aging and compliance with contractual dispute resolution timelines.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Agreement Dispute Resolution Clause

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer has formally disputed the OEM's decision on this claim (e.g., disputed rejection or adjusted amount). True = claim is under dispute; False = no dispute raised. Triggers escalation workflow in Salesforce Automotive Cloud.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Agreement Dispute Resolution Clause; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the outcome and resolution of a dealer dispute on this claim. Captures the agreed resolution, any revised approved amount, and the basis for the final decision. Supports audit trail and dealer relationship management.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Agreement; Salesforce Automotive Cloud Case Management

attributes.name: dms_claim_reference
attributes.description: Claim reference number as recorded in the dealer's CDK Global DMS system. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the OEM's incentive claim record and the dealer's own DMS records. Critical for audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Integration; OEM-Dealer Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: evidence_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the supporting evidence package submitted by the dealer with the claim (e.g., sales invoices, PDI records, customer satisfaction survey results, parts purchase orders). Stored in the document management system linked from CDK Global DMS or Salesforce Automotive Cloud.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Document Management; IATF 16949 Records Control

attributes.name: evidence_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OEM reviewer has verified the supporting evidence submitted with the claim. True = evidence reviewed and confirmed valid; False = evidence not yet verified or found insufficient. Used to gate claim approval workflow.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Audit Policy; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) associated with the units or transactions being claimed. Used to align incentive claims with specific model year programs and OEM production cycles (e.g., MY2024, MY2025).
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Order; OEM Model Year Program Guidelines

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Actual monetary amount disbursed to the dealer for this claim. May differ from approved_amount due to netting, offsets, or partial payment arrangements. Populated upon payment confirmation from SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Document; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved incentive amount was disbursed to the dealer's bank account. Populated upon payment confirmation from SAP FI. Used for cash flow reporting and dealer payment aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Run; OEM Dealer Payment Terms

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology category of the vehicles covered by this claim. Values: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), EV (Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Used to track EV/electrification incentive program uptake and CAFE compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Emissions Standards; CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) Regulations; CARB ZEV Mandate

attributes.name: program_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter of the OEM incentive program period covered by this claim (Q1–Q4). Used for quarterly accrual reporting, dealer performance benchmarking, and incentive budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: OEM Quarterly Incentive Program Schedule; SAP FI Period Accounting

attributes.name: program_year
attributes.description: Fiscal or calendar year of the OEM incentive program under which this claim is filed. Used to segregate claims by annual program cycle for budget tracking, accrual management, and year-end financial close in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SAP FI Fiscal Year; OEM Annual Incentive Program Calendar

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: OEM sales region or zone code to which the submitting dealer belongs. Used for regional incentive program management, territory-based performance benchmarking, and regional finance reporting.
attributes.references: OEM Sales Region Hierarchy; SAP SD Sales Organization

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation provided by the OEM reviewer when a claim is rejected (claim_status = rejected). Documents the specific grounds for denial to support dealer dispute resolution and compliance with IATF 16949 dealer management requirements.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the OEM completed the review of the incentive claim and updated the claim_status to approved or rejected. Used for SLA tracking of claim processing turnaround time.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive SLA Policy; SAP FI Workflow

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI accounting document number generated when the incentive claim liability or payment is posted in the general ledger. Provides direct traceability between the incentive claim and the SAP FI financial posting for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Management; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the dealer formally submitted the incentive claim to the OEM. This is the principal business event date for the claim lifecycle and is used for period-end cut-off and aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI Posting Date Rules; OEM Dealer Agreement

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the incentive claim record. Tracks the last modification for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake CDC; IATF 16949 Records Management

products.name: floor_plan
products.description: Dealer vehicle floor plan financing records tracking the financing of new vehicle inventory. Captures financing institution, credit line amount, outstanding balance, per-unit floor plan cost, curtailment schedule, aged inventory flags, and floor plan audit dates. Critical for dealer financial health monitoring and OEM floor plan assistance program administration.

attributes.name: floor_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the floor plan financing record.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Floor plan financing creates a liability requiring specific GL account assignment for balance sheet reporting, interest expense tracking, and lender reconciliation in automotive dealer wholesale finan

attributes.name: primary_floor_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer holding this floor plan financing arrangement.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Floor plan financing is per‑vehicle; linking to VIN registry enables accurate interest calculation and balance tracking.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Unique account number assigned by the financing institution to the dealer's floor plan credit facility.

attributes.name: aged_inventory_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator flagging vehicles that have exceeded the aging threshold defined in the floor plan agreement (typically 90, 120, or 180 days). True indicates aged inventory requiring attention.

attributes.name: aging_threshold_days
attributes.description: Number of days after which inventory is considered aged per the floor plan agreement terms. Triggers curtailment requirements or OEM assistance programs.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Result status of the most recent floor plan audit. Passed indicates compliance; failed indicates discrepancies; pending indicates audit in progress; not_required indicates no audit needed; exception indicates special circumstances.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this floor plan financing record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_line_amount
attributes.description: Total credit line amount approved by the financing institution for the dealer's floor plan facility. Represents the maximum borrowing capacity.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this floor plan record (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD).

attributes.name: curtailment_amount
attributes.description: Required curtailment payment amount for aged inventory, typically a percentage of the original financed amount after a specified aging period (e.g., 90 or 120 days).

attributes.name: curtailment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the dealer must make a curtailment payment (partial paydown) on aged inventory per the floor plan agreement terms.

attributes.name: curtailment_paid_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the required curtailment payment has been made by the dealer. True indicates paid; False indicates outstanding.

attributes.name: daily_interest_amount
attributes.description: Daily interest accrual amount calculated based on the outstanding balance and interest rate. Used for dealer financial health monitoring.

attributes.name: days_in_inventory
attributes.description: Number of days the vehicle has been in dealer inventory under floor plan financing, calculated from financing start date to current date or sale date.

attributes.name: dealer_invoice_amount
attributes.description: Original dealer invoice amount for the vehicle, typically the basis for the floor plan financed amount.

attributes.name: default_date
attributes.description: Date when the dealer was declared in default on floor plan obligations for this vehicle. Null if no default has occurred.

attributes.name: default_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the dealer has defaulted on floor plan payments for this vehicle. True indicates default; False indicates current status.

attributes.name: dms_floor_plan_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dealer Management System (DMS) Floor Plan ID
attributes.description: External identifier for this floor plan record in the dealer's DMS (e.g., CDK Global). Used for system integration and reconciliation.

attributes.name: financing_end_date
attributes.description: Date when floor plan financing for this vehicle unit was terminated, either through retail sale and payoff or other resolution.

attributes.name: financing_institution_code
attributes.description: Internal or industry-standard code identifying the financing institution for system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: financing_institution_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution or captive finance company providing the floor plan credit line (e.g., OEM captive finance, third-party lender).

attributes.name: financing_start_date
attributes.description: Date when floor plan financing for this vehicle unit commenced. Typically the date the vehicle was received into dealer inventory and financed.

attributes.name: floor_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the floor plan financing record. Active indicates ongoing financing; paid_off indicates vehicle sold and financing settled; defaulted indicates payment failure; suspended indicates temporary hold; pending_audit indicates under review; curtailed indicates partial paydown required.

attributes.name: interest_rate_pct
attributes.description: Annual interest rate percentage charged by the financing institution on the outstanding floor plan balance for this vehicle.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent floor plan audit conducted by the financing institution or OEM to verify physical inventory and compliance with financing terms.

attributes.name: msrp_amount
attributes.description: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price for the financed vehicle. Used for margin analysis and dealer financial health assessment.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next floor plan audit. Used for audit planning and dealer notification.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special circumstances related to this floor plan financing record (e.g., audit exceptions, payment arrangements, OEM approvals).

attributes.name: oem_assistance_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of OEM assistance provided for this floor plan record, such as interest rate buy-down or direct payment subsidy.

attributes.name: oem_assistance_program_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Assistance Program Code
attributes.description: Code identifying any OEM floor plan assistance program applied to this vehicle (e.g., interest subsidy, extended aging allowance, special financing terms for slow-moving models).

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_amount
attributes.description: Current outstanding principal balance owed to the financing institution for this specific vehicle unit. Updated upon curtailment payments and final payoff.

attributes.name: payoff_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid to the financing institution to settle the floor plan obligation for this vehicle, including principal and accrued interest.

attributes.name: payoff_date
attributes.description: Date when the floor plan financing for this vehicle was fully paid off, typically upon retail sale or dealer buyout.

attributes.name: per_unit_floor_plan_cost
attributes.description: The financed amount for this individual vehicle unit, typically equal to dealer invoice or a percentage thereof. Basis for interest calculation.

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: SAP financial document number associated with the floor plan financing transaction in the OEM's ERP system (SAP S/4HANA FI module).

attributes.name: total_interest_paid
attributes.description: Cumulative interest amount paid to the financing institution over the life of the floor plan financing for this vehicle unit.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this floor plan financing record was last modified. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

products.name: tsb_part_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the parts bill-of-materials specified in a Technical Service Bulletin. Each record links one TSB to one service part with attributes that define the part's role, quantity, and revision requirements for executing the repair procedure described in the bulletin. This is actively managed by OEM parts engineering and used by dealer parts departments for inventory pre-positioning.. Existence Justification: In automotive aftersales operations, Technical Service Bulletins specify a bill-of-materials (parts list) required to execute the repair procedure, and service parts are referenced across multiple TSBs as they apply to different symptoms, model years, or VIN ranges. OEM parts engineering actively manages this relationship as 'TSB Part Requirements' or 'Repair Kit Definitions' to enable dealer parts departments to pre-position inventory. The current model's denormalized STRING fields (tsb.required_parts, tsb.part_revision) are clear evidence that this M:N relationship has been collapsed into a single record and should be normalized.

attributes.description: Warranty program code if this line represents warranty coverage. Identifies the specific warranty plan or extended service contract being billed.

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: payment
products.description: Record of a payment received against an invoice or account balance from a dealer, retail customer, fleet operator, or corporate account. Captures payment date, payment method (wire/ACH/check/credit_card/floorplan/dealer_draft), payment amount, currency, applied invoice references, bank reference number, clearing date, payment status (pending/cleared/returned/reversed), SAP FI clearing document reference, and payer entity type. SSOT for all inbound payment receipts in the billing domain.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment record. Primary key for the payment entity.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: A payment is made against a billing account. While payment already links to invoice (which links to account), a direct account_id FK on payment enables efficient account-level payment queries, reconci

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Payments must be recorded against the receiving legal entity for cash management, bank reconciliation, and intercompany settlement in multi-entity automotive operations.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Payments are charged to a cost center for cash‑flow and expense tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Cash accounting and treasury reporting require payments assigned to fiscal periods for liquidity analysis, DSO calculation, and cash flow statement preparation.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Cash receipt posting requires a GL account to record the payment in the ledger.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice against which this payment is applied. Links payment to the billing document.

attributes.name: payment_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the entity making the payment (dealer, retail customer, fleet operator, or corporate account).

attributes.name: payment_payer_entity_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the entity making the payment (dealer, retail customer, fleet operator, or corporate account).

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_plan. Business justification: When a payment is made as an installment under a structured payment plan, the payment must reference the payment_plan it belongs to. This enables tracking of installment fulfillment, outstanding balan

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit‑center reporting of cash receipts requires linking payments to the responsible profit center.

attributes.name: rebate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.rebate_agreement. Business justification: Rebate agreements generate periodic settlement payments to dealers or fleet accounts. Linking payment.rebate_agreement_id to rebate_agreement enables tracking of which payments represent rebate settle

attributes.name: receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.receivable. Business justification: A payment directly reduces an open receivable. Linking payment.receivable_id to receivable enables direct AR management — tracking which receivable a payment closes or partially reduces, supporting du

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary value of the payment received before any adjustments or fees.

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment amount that has been successfully applied to outstanding invoices or account balances.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code provided by the payment processor or bank confirming approval of the payment transaction.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number from which the payment originated. Masked or tokenized for security. Used for reconciliation and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: bank_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the bank or financial institution for the payment transaction. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: batch_reference
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch or group of payments processed together. Used for bulk payment processing and reconciliation.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Interface or channel through which the payment was submitted. Distinguishes between online portal, mobile app, bank transfer, mail, and in-person payments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: online_portal|mobile_app|bank_transfer|mail|in_person|automated_system|dealer_system — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was cleared and funds were confirmed as received in the company bank account.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system that created the payment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Discount amount granted for early payment according to payment terms (e.g., 2% discount for payment within 10 days).

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment is currently under dispute or has been disputed by the payer or payee.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for payment dispute. Populated only when dispute_flag is true.

attributes.name: lockbox_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the bank lockbox service used to receive and process the payment. Applicable for check and mail payments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the payment. May include remittance advice, special instructions, or reconciliation notes.

attributes.name: payer_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity making the payment. Distinguishes between dealer payments, retail customer payments, fleet operator payments, and corporate account payments.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was initiated or received by the payer. Represents the business event date of the payment transaction.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism used to make the payment. Includes wire transfer, ACH (Automated Clearing House), check, credit card, floorplan financing, and dealer draft. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wire_transfer|ach|check|credit_card|debit_card|floorplan_financing|dealer_draft|electronic_funds_transfer|cash|promissory_note — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for the payment transaction. Used for customer communication and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment. Tracks whether the payment is pending, cleared, returned, reversed, or cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|cleared|returned|reversed|cancelled|on_hold|partially_applied — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: processor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party payment processor or gateway used to process the payment (e.g., Stripe, PayPal, bank name).

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was reconciled with bank statements and confirmed in the accounting system.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the payment has been successfully reconciled with bank statements and accounting records.

attributes.name: remittance_advice
attributes.description: Detailed remittance information provided by the payer indicating which invoices or charges this payment is intended to cover.

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was returned or reversed by the bank or payment processor. Populated only when payment status is returned or reversed.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for payment return or reversal (e.g., insufficient funds, account closed, stop payment). Populated only when payment status is returned or reversed.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing number or SWIFT code for the payer financial institution. Used for wire transfers and ACH (Automated Clearing House) transactions.

attributes.name: sap_clearing_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Clearing Document Number
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP FI clearing document that records the application of this payment to open invoices. Links payment to financial accounting records.

attributes.name: sap_payment_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Payment Document Number
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP FI payment document that records the receipt of this payment. Primary link to ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) financial records.

attributes.name: terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms under which this payment was made (e.g., net 30, net 60, immediate). Links to master payment terms reference.

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment processor or gateway. Used for tracking and reconciliation with external systems.

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment amount that remains unapplied and is held as credit on the payer account.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system that last modified the payment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: payment_allocation
products.description: Association record linking a payment to one or more invoice lines, capturing how a single payment is distributed across multiple invoices or partial invoice settlements. Tracks allocated amount per invoice, allocation date, allocation type (full/partial/advance/overpayment), remaining balance after allocation, and clearing status. Enables accurate accounts receivable aging and open item management aligned with SAP FI open item clearing.

attributes.name: payment_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment allocation record. Primary key for the payment allocation entity.

attributes.name: account_id
