attributes.name: dealer_incentive_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.dealer_incentive_claim. Business justification: Payment allocations distribute payments across specific incentive claims when one payment covers multiple claims. Standard payment application process for batch incentive settlements.

attributes.name: dealer_warranty_claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.dealer_warranty_claim. Business justification: Payment allocations distribute payments across specific warranty claims. Enables multi-claim payment settlement - standard for batch warranty reimbursement processing.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Cash application and revenue recognition require allocation transactions assigned to fiscal periods for accurate period-end cash reconciliation and revenue cutoff controls.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice receiving the payment allocation. Links to the invoice document being settled or partially settled by this allocation.

attributes.name: invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific invoice line item being settled. Enables line-level payment allocation for partial settlements and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment transaction being allocated. Links to the payment record that is being distributed across one or more invoices.

attributes.name: recall_completion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.recall_completion. Business justification: Payment allocations distribute payments across specific recall completions when batched. Standard recall reimbursement settlement - enables completion-level payment tracking for campaign cost manageme

attributes.name: receivable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.receivable. Business justification: Payment allocation records how a payment is applied against invoice lines. Linking payment_allocation.receivable_id to receivable enables direct tracking of which open receivable item is being cleared

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount from the payment that is allocated to this specific invoice or invoice line. Represents the portion of the total payment applied to settle this receivable.

attributes.name: allocated_amount_base_currency
attributes.description: The allocated amount converted to the company base currency using the exchange rate. Enables consolidated financial reporting and accounts receivable aging in a single currency.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment was allocated to the invoice. Represents the business event date for accounts receivable clearing and aging calculations.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to create the allocation. Automatic indicates system-matched allocation, manual indicates user-created allocation, system_proposed indicates system suggestion requiring approval, batch_clearing indicates mass clearing process.

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the payment allocation. Used for tracking and reference in accounts receivable operations and customer communications.

attributes.name: allocation_priority
attributes.description: Priority sequence for applying payment when multiple invoices are eligible. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used in automatic allocation rules and aging calculations.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment allocation. Pending indicates awaiting confirmation, cleared indicates successfully applied, reversed indicates allocation has been undone, disputed indicates under investigation, reconciled indicates confirmed and balanced, voided indicates cancelled allocation.

attributes.name: allocation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the payment allocation was recorded in the system. Used for audit trail and transaction sequencing.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allocation method. Full indicates complete invoice settlement, partial indicates partial payment, advance indicates prepayment before invoice, overpayment indicates excess payment requiring refund or credit, credit_memo indicates credit note application, adjustment indicates manual correction.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation was approved. Null for automatic allocations not requiring approval. Used for workflow tracking and compliance audit.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP business area for segment reporting. Enables revenue and receivables analysis by business unit, product line, or geographic region.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI clearing document number that records the open item clearing transaction. Links the payment allocation to the financial accounting clearing entry.

attributes.name: clearing_status
attributes.description: Status of the open item clearing in SAP FI. Open indicates invoice not yet settled, cleared indicates fully settled, partially_cleared indicates partial payment applied, reset indicates clearing was reversed.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity receiving the payment. Enables multi-entity financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the payment allocation record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allocated amount. Supports multi-currency billing and payment scenarios common in global automotive sales and dealer networks.

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer or customer account associated with this payment allocation. Enables dealer-level accounts receivable reporting and performance tracking.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Early payment discount amount applied during this allocation. Common in automotive dealer invoicing where prompt payment terms offer percentage discounts.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate of the cash discount applied. Typically defined in payment terms and calculated based on payment timing relative to invoice date.

attributes.name: dispute_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this allocation is under dispute. True indicates customer has contested the invoice or payment application.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the dispute reason. Captures customer explanation for contesting the allocation or invoice amount.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied when payment currency differs from invoice currency. Used for cross-currency allocation calculations and financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the payment allocation occurred. Used for period-based financial reporting and accounts receivable aging analysis.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the payment allocation record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the payment allocation. Used for documenting special circumstances, manual adjustments, or customer communications.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the allocation was posted to the general ledger. May differ from allocation date due to period-end processing or backdated corrections.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center responsible for this revenue transaction. Used for internal management accounting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the allocation in the accounts receivable reconciliation process. Pending indicates awaiting reconciliation, reconciled indicates confirmed and balanced, exception indicates discrepancy requiring investigation, under_review indicates active reconciliation in progress.

attributes.name: remaining_invoice_balance
attributes.description: The outstanding balance remaining on the invoice after this allocation is applied. Zero indicates full settlement. Used for open item management and accounts receivable aging.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation was reversed. Null if allocation has not been reversed. Used for audit trail and accounts receivable reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this allocation has been reversed. True indicates the allocation was subsequently undone, typically due to payment failure or correction.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for allocation reversal. Examples include payment failure, incorrect allocation, duplicate payment, or customer dispute.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system that originated this payment allocation record. Examples include SAP_FI, CDK_DMS, SALESFORCE. Enables data lineage tracking in multi-system environments.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date for cash flow and liquidity management. Represents when funds are actually available in the bank account.

products.name: account
products.description: Billing account master record representing the financial relationship between Automotive and a billing party (dealer, retail customer, fleet operator, or corporate account). Captures account number, account type (dealer/retail/fleet/corporate/government), account name, billing address, payment terms, credit limit, credit exposure, currency, tax registration number, VAT ID, account status (active/suspended/closed), assigned credit controller, SAP FI customer account reference, and DMS account linkage for dealer accounts. Distinct from the customer identity record owned by the customer domain.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing account. Primary key.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Customer accounts must be assigned to a company code for legal entity-level AR aging, credit limit management, and statutory customer master data in automotive dealer networks.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assigns a default cost center to the billing account for expense allocation.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Default GL account for all transactions posted from a billing account for consistent accounting.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Financial reporting requires mapping each billing account to a jurisdiction for tax and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: parent_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent billing account for hierarchical account structures. Used for corporate accounts with multiple subsidiaries or dealer groups with multiple locations. Null for standalone accounts.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Account Management Report requires linking each billing account to its owning customer party for credit limits, statements, and compliance.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Legal or registered name of the billing party. For dealers, this is the dealership legal entity name. For retail customers, the individual or household name. For fleet/corporate, the company legal name.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique account number assigned to the billing party. Used on invoices, statements, and payment correspondence. Typically alphanumeric format following internal numbering scheme.

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing account. Active accounts can transact normally. Suspended accounts have temporary restrictions. Closed accounts are permanently terminated. Pending approval accounts await credit review. Blocked accounts cannot transact due to payment issues. Dormant accounts have no recent activity.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing account based on the nature of the billing party. Dealer accounts are for franchise dealerships, retail for individual consumers, fleet for commercial fleet operators, corporate for B2B accounts, government for public sector entities, and export for international distributors.

attributes.name: auto_pay_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account is enrolled in automatic payment processing. True when account has authorized automatic ACH, direct debit, or credit card charges for recurring invoices.

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for billing correspondence and invoice delivery. First line of the billing party's registered address.

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, apartment, building, or additional location details for billing correspondence.

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for the billing address.

attributes.name: billing_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary billing contact person. Used for invoice inquiries, payment confirmations, and account correspondence.

attributes.name: billing_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary billing contact person at the billing party organization. Accounts payable manager, controller, or designated billing representative.

attributes.name: billing_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the billing contact. Used for payment inquiries, dispute resolution, and collections communication.

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the billing address country (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, DEU, CHN, JPN).

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the billing address. Format varies by country.

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional administrative division for the billing address. Format varies by country (e.g., two-letter US state codes, Canadian province codes).

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the billing account was permanently closed. Null for active, suspended, or dormant accounts. Set when account status transitions to closed after final settlement.
attributes.references: SAP FI Customer Master Deletion Date

attributes.name: consolidated_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account receives consolidated invoices combining multiple transactions or sub-accounts into a single statement. Common for fleet and corporate accounts with multiple locations or cost centers.

attributes.name: credit_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent credit review or credit check performed for this account. Credit reviews are typically performed at account opening, annually, or when credit limit increase is requested.

attributes.name: credit_exposure_amount
attributes.description: Current total outstanding receivables balance for this account, including open invoices and unbilled charges. Updated in near-real-time as transactions post. Compared against credit limit for credit control decisions.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding receivables balance allowed for this account before credit hold is triggered. Expressed in the account's base currency. Set by credit management based on creditworthiness assessment.

attributes.name: credit_rating_code
attributes.description: Internal or external credit rating assigned to the billing party. AAA is highest creditworthiness, D is default, NR is not rated. Used for credit limit determination and risk management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D|NR — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the account's base transactional currency (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD, MXN, CNY, JPY). All invoices and payments for this account are denominated in this currency unless explicitly converted.

attributes.name: dispute_count_ytd
attributes.description: Number of billing disputes or invoice challenges raised by this account in the current fiscal year. Used to identify problematic accounts and improve billing accuracy.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP distribution channel code indicating how products reach this account (e.g., direct sales, dealer network, fleet sales, export). Affects pricing and terms determination.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: SAP division code representing the product line or business unit (e.g., passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, parts, service). Used for revenue segmentation and reporting.

attributes.name: dms_account_code
attributes.description: External account identifier from the dealer management system (CDK Global DMS) for dealer accounts. Used to link billing account to dealer inventory, service, and F&I transactions. Null for non-dealer account types.

attributes.name: dunning_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated dunning (collections) notices are blocked for this account. True when account is in dispute resolution, payment plan, or has special handling requirements.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning (collections) level for overdue accounts. Ranges from 0 (no overdue) to higher numbers indicating escalating collection actions. Drives automated dunning letter generation and collection workflow.

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for delivering invoices and statements to the billing party. Email for electronic delivery, postal mail for paper, EDI for automated B2B integration, portal for self-service access, fax for legacy systems.

attributes.name: invoice_email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for electronic invoice and statement delivery. Used when invoice delivery method is email or as backup contact for portal notifications.

attributes.name: last_invoice_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent invoice issued to this account. Used to identify dormant accounts and track billing activity patterns.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent payment received from this account in the account's base currency. Used for payment pattern analysis and collections strategy.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received from this account. Used for credit assessment, collections prioritization, and customer relationship management.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the billing account was first established and activated. Marks the beginning of the financial relationship.
attributes.references: SAP FI Customer Master Creation Date

attributes.name: payment_method_preference
attributes.description: Preferred payment method for this account. Wire transfer and ACH for electronic payments, check for paper payments, credit card for retail, direct debit for recurring charges, letter of credit for export accounts.

attributes.name: payment_performance_score
attributes.description: Calculated score (0-100) representing the account's payment timeliness and reliability. Based on historical payment patterns, days sales outstanding, and dispute frequency. Higher scores indicate better payment performance.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code defining the due date calculation and discount conditions (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30). Maps to SAP FI payment terms master data.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date until payment is due. Derived from payment terms code but stored for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing account record was first created in the data platform. System-generated audit field.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing account record was last modified in the data platform. System-generated audit field updated on every change.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: SAP sales organization code responsible for this billing account. Defines the organizational unit for sales and distribution processes, pricing, and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: sap_customer_number
attributes.description: SAP FI customer account number (KUNNR) in the ERP system. Ten-digit numeric identifier used for financial postings, invoice generation, and payment application. Primary system of record reference.

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number for the billing party. Format varies by jurisdiction (e.g., EIN in USA, GST number in Canada, RFC in Mexico, VAT number in EU). Used for tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: vat_number
attributes.description: VAT registration identifier for EU and other VAT jurisdictions. Required for cross-border invoicing and VAT reclaim. Format follows country-specific VAT ID structure.

products.name: receivable
products.description: Open accounts receivable item representing an outstanding amount owed by a billing account against a specific invoice. Tracks original invoice amount, outstanding balance, due date, days past due, aging bucket (current/30/60/90/120+), dunning level, last dunning date, dispute flag, dispute reference, write-off flag, and SAP FI open item reference. SSOT for AR aging and collections management across dealer, retail, and fleet receivables.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source invoice that generated this receivable. Links to the originating billing document in SAP SD/FI.

attributes.name: payment_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active payment plan agreement if payment_plan_flag is true. Links to payment plan schedule and terms.

attributes.name: vehicle_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.vehicle_order. Business justification: Receivables track amounts due from vehicle orders. Essential for aging analysis, collections, and credit hold decisions. Links AR records to originating sales transactions for dispute resolution and p

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Automotive receivables for vehicle sales are tracked against specific VINs for collections, dispute resolution, and lien management. The existing plain 'vin' text column is denormalized; a proper FK t

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Standard aging classification bucket based on days past due. Used for AR aging reports, bad debt provisioning, and collections prioritization.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date the receivable was fully closed (paid, written off, or otherwise resolved). Null for open receivables. Used for DSO calculation and historical analysis.

attributes.name: collection_status
attributes.description: Current status of collection efforts for overdue receivables. Tracks progression through collections workflow from initial contact to legal action. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_started|in_progress|on_hold|escalated|legal|resolved|abandoned — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center responsible for the revenue transaction that generated this receivable. Used for profitability analysis and management reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this receivable record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the debtor account is on credit hold due to this or other overdue receivables. Credit hold blocks new orders and shipments.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the receivable amounts. Supports multi-currency operations across global dealer networks and export markets.

attributes.name: customer_type
attributes.description: Segment classification of the debtor. Distinguishes dealer network, retail consumers, fleet operators, government entities, rental companies, and leasing firms.

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the receivable is overdue. Calculated as current date minus due date for unpaid balances. Zero or negative for current receivables.

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: Dealer code if the receivable is from a dealer network transaction. Links to dealer master data for dealer-specific AR aging and floor plan management.

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date the dispute was raised by the debtor. Used to track dispute aging and resolution SLA compliance.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the receivable is currently under dispute by the debtor. Disputed receivables are excluded from dunning and may be placed on payment hold.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the dispute if dispute_flag is true. Categorizes the nature of the customer objection for resolution tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pricing_error|quantity_discrepancy|quality_issue|delivery_problem|warranty_claim|incentive_disagreement|billing_error|not_disputed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dispute_reference
attributes.description: External reference number for the dispute case. Links to dispute resolution system or customer service ticket.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractual date by which payment is expected. Calculated from invoice date plus payment terms. Used to determine days past due and aging bucket.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning escalation level for overdue receivables. Increments with each dunning run. Zero indicates no dunning action taken.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code where this receivable is posted. Typically an AR control account in the balance sheet.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the originating invoice was issued. Represents the business event timestamp when the receivable was created.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent contact attempt with the debtor regarding this receivable. Includes phone calls, emails, and letters.

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Date the most recent dunning notice was sent to the debtor. Used to calculate next dunning run eligibility and escalation timing.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this receivable record. Tracks changes to balance, status, or dispute information.

attributes.name: next_dunning_date
attributes.description: Calculated date for the next dunning notice. Based on dunning frequency configuration and last dunning date.

attributes.name: original_amount
attributes.description: Original gross amount of the receivable at invoice creation. Represents the initial debt obligation before any payments or adjustments.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Current unpaid balance remaining on the receivable. Calculated as original amount minus payments, credits, and adjustments. SSOT for AR aging reports.

attributes.name: payment_plan_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the debtor is on an approved payment plan for this receivable. Payment plan receivables follow modified dunning rules.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms governing the receivable. Defines the number of days until payment is due and any early payment discounts. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_30|net_45|net_60|net_90|due_on_receipt|2_10_net_30|custom — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center for internal P&L reporting. Represents the business unit or product line that earned this revenue.

attributes.name: receivable_number
attributes.description: Business-facing document number for the receivable item. Externally visible identifier used in collections correspondence and dunning letters.

attributes.name: receivable_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the receivable. Tracks progression from open through payment, dispute, collections, or write-off. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|partially_paid|paid|disputed|written_off|under_collection|legal_action — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: receivable_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receivable by business transaction type. Distinguishes vehicle sales, parts, service, warranty, fleet, incentive recovery, and finance charges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vehicle_sale|parts_sale|service_charge|warranty_reimbursement|fleet_invoice|incentive_recovery|finance_charge — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sales_region
attributes.description: Geographic sales region where the transaction occurred. Used for regional revenue and collections performance analysis.

attributes.name: sap_fi_company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity that owns this receivable. Used for multi-entity consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI accounting document number for the open item. SSOT reference for reconciliation with SAP general ledger and subledger.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount written off as bad debt. May differ from outstanding balance if partial recovery was achieved before write-off.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date the receivable was written off. Represents the accounting period when the bad debt expense was recognized.

attributes.name: write_off_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the receivable has been written off as uncollectible bad debt. Written-off receivables are removed from active AR aging.

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the write-off decision. Documents the business justification for recognizing bad debt expense. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bankruptcy|insolvency|uncollectible|customer_closure|legal_settlement|small_balance|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: dealer_statement
products.description: Periodic account statement issued to a dealer summarizing all invoices, credit memos, debit memos, payments, and open balances within a statement period. Captures statement number, dealer account reference, statement period start/end dates, opening balance, total charges, total credits, total payments received, closing balance, statement status (draft/issued/acknowledged), and CDK Global DMS statement reference. Supports dealer reconciliation and floorplan financing reporting.

attributes.name: dealer_statement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer statement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Dealer statements represent financial obligations tracked by legal entity for consolidation, dealer financing programs, and floorplan liability reporting in automotive distribution networks.

attributes.name: dealer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: Dealer statements are issued per dealer account; linking to the master account removes the redundant dealer_account_number column.

attributes.name: dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership receiving this statement.

attributes.name: fiscal_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fiscal_period. Business justification: Dealer statement reconciliation and period-close processes require fiscal period assignment for monthly dealer account settlement and financial reporting cutoff.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Dealer statements must track jurisdiction for tax reporting, VAT/GST compliance, and multi-market regulatory requirements. Automotive OEMs operate across jurisdictions with different tax rates, report

attributes.name: aging_bucket_30_days_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing balance that is 1-30 days past due.

attributes.name: aging_bucket_60_days_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing balance that is 31-60 days past due.

attributes.name: aging_bucket_90_days_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing balance that is 61-90 days past due.

attributes.name: aging_bucket_current_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing balance that is current and not yet past due.

attributes.name: aging_bucket_over_90_days_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the closing balance that is more than 90 days past due.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the billing cycle or schedule under which this statement was generated.
attributes.references: SAP SD Billing Schedule Master Data

attributes.name: cdk_statement_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier from CDK Global DMS linking this statement to the dealer management system record.

attributes.name: closing_balance_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding balance at the end of the statement period, calculated as opening balance plus charges minus credits and payments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dealer statement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this statement.

attributes.name: dispute_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount under dispute by the dealer, if any.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer has raised a dispute or discrepancy regarding this statement.

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: Code representing the reason for the dispute, such as pricing error, quantity discrepancy, or missing credit.
attributes.references: SAP FI Dispute Reason Master Data

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP distribution channel code indicating the route to market for this statement.
attributes.references: SAP SD Distribution Channel Master Data

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year for this statement.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this statement period falls, used for financial reporting and period alignment.

attributes.name: floorplan_financing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this statement includes floorplan financing charges or is relevant for floorplan reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dealer statement record was last updated.

attributes.name: opening_balance_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding balance carried forward from the previous statement period.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the dealer is expected to remit payment for the closing balance.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms applicable to this statement, such as net 30, net 60, or custom terms.
attributes.references: SAP SD Payment Terms Master Data

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dealer acknowledged and reconciled this statement with their own records.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: SAP sales organization code responsible for this dealer statement.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Organization Master Data

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the statement was generated and issued to the dealer.

attributes.name: statement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or instructions related to this statement.

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the dealer statement, externally visible and used for dealer reconciliation and reference.
attributes.references: SAP SD Billing Document Number Standard

attributes.name: statement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the billing period covered by this statement.

attributes.name: statement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the billing period covered by this statement.

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dealer statement indicating its processing stage.

attributes.name: statement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the statement based on its frequency or purpose.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Statement Type Classification

attributes.name: total_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all manual adjustments applied to the dealer account during the statement period, including corrections and write-offs.
attributes.references: SAP FI Manual Journal Entry Standard

attributes.name: total_credit_memo_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all credit memos issued to the dealer during the statement period, reducing the amount owed.

attributes.name: total_debit_memo_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all debit memos issued to the dealer during the statement period, increasing the amount owed.

attributes.name: total_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all dealer incentives, rebates, and promotional credits applied during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_invoice_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all invoices issued to the dealer during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_parts_sales_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all parts sales invoices included in this statement period.

attributes.name: total_payment_received_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all payments received from the dealer during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_service_charges_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all service and labor charges included in this statement period.

attributes.name: total_vehicle_sales_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all vehicle sales invoices included in this statement period.

attributes.name: total_warranty_reimbursement_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all warranty claim reimbursements credited to the dealer during the statement period.

products.name: price_condition
products.description: Pricing condition record defining the applicable price, discount, surcharge, or tax condition for a billing transaction based on customer type, vehicle model, region, and validity period. Captures condition type (MSRP/negotiated/fleet_discount/dealer_margin/volume_rebate/freight/PDI_charge/tax), condition value, condition unit, scale basis, validity start/end dates, pricing procedure reference, and SAP SD condition record reference (KONP/KONV). Supports both MSRP-based and negotiated pricing models as required by the billing domain.

attributes.name: price_condition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the price condition record. Primary key.

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: SAP SD price condition records in automotive are keyed to vehicle models — MSRP uplifts, fleet discounts, and market-specific pricing are all model-scoped. The existing vehicle_model_code is a denorma

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sku_master. Business justification: Price conditions must specify which parts/materials SKUs they apply to. Critical for parts pricing management, dealer pricing agreements, and service parts catalog pricing in automotive distribution.

attributes.name: transport_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.transport_rate. Business justification: Billing price conditions for logistics services derive from contracted transport rates. Pricing procedures must reference transport rate master data to calculate invoice line amounts, apply fuel surch

attributes.name: trim_level_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vehicle_trim_level. Business justification: Automotive price conditions are frequently scoped to trim levels — premium trim commands different pricing conditions than base trim. The existing vehicle_trim_level plain text is denormalized; a prop

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Automotive price conditions (MSRP, dealer net, fleet pricing) are defined per vehicle program and model year. Linking billing_price_condition to vehicle_program enables program-level pricing governanc

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether application of this pricing condition requires managerial or pricing authority approval before being applied to a billing transaction. True requires approval workflow.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the pricing authority or manager who approved this condition for use in billing transactions. Null if approval is not required or pending.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing condition was approved for use. Null if approval is not required or still pending. Part of the governance audit trail.

attributes.name: calculation_type
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the condition value in the billing transaction. Defines whether the condition is applied as a fixed amount, percentage of base, quantity-dependent, or using a tiered/formula approach.

attributes.name: condition_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the condition type grouping similar pricing elements together for reporting and analysis purposes.

attributes.name: condition_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the pricing condition, including its business purpose, applicability rules, and any special terms or restrictions. Provides context for pricing analysts and auditors.

attributes.name: condition_exclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this condition is marked for exclusion from certain pricing scenarios or customer groups. True means the condition should be excluded under specific business rules.

attributes.name: condition_record_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the pricing condition record, typically sourced from SAP SD condition record (KONP table). Used for external reference and traceability.

attributes.name: condition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pricing condition record. Active conditions are available for use in billing; inactive, expired, or suspended conditions are not applied.

attributes.name: condition_step_number
attributes.description: Sequence number within the pricing procedure that defines the order in which this condition is evaluated and applied during billing calculation.

attributes.name: condition_type
attributes.description: Type of pricing condition applied to the billing transaction. Defines whether this is a base price (MSRP), negotiated price, discount, surcharge, tax, or other pricing element. Aligns with SAP SD condition types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: msrp|negotiated|fleet_discount|dealer_margin|volume_rebate|freight|pdi_charge|tax|surcharge|promotional_discount — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: condition_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the condition value. Indicates whether the value is an absolute amount, a percentage, or a per-unit rate.

attributes.name: condition_value
attributes.description: Monetary or percentage value of the pricing condition. For absolute amounts, represents the price or adjustment in the condition currency. For percentage-based conditions, represents the rate (e.g., 5.5 for 5.5%).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing condition record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for master data lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the condition value when expressed as an absolute amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: customer_type
attributes.description: Type of customer for which this pricing condition is applicable. Enables customer segment-specific pricing strategies (retail, fleet, dealer, government, commercial).

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the dealer or dealership for which this pricing condition is applicable. Enables dealer-specific pricing agreements and margin structures. Null indicates condition applies to all dealers.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_code
attributes.description: SAP SD distribution channel code indicating the sales channel (e.g., retail, fleet, online) for which this condition applies. Enables channel-specific pricing strategies.

attributes.name: effective_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when this pricing condition record version is superseded or becomes inactive in the lakehouse. Null indicates the current active version. Used for SCD Type 2 tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when this pricing condition record becomes effective in the lakehouse. Used for temporal queries and slowly changing dimension (SCD) Type 2 tracking.

attributes.name: is_current_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents the current active version of the pricing condition. True for the latest version, False for historical versions. Supports SCD Type 2 queries.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this pricing condition record. Supports change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pricing condition record was last modified. Enables change detection and version control for pricing master data.

attributes.name: manual_override_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sales or billing personnel are permitted to manually override this condition value during transaction processing. True allows manual adjustment, False enforces system-determined value.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model year of the vehicle for which this pricing condition is applicable. Enables year-over-year pricing adjustments and end-of-model-year promotions.

attributes.name: pricing_procedure_code
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD pricing procedure that governs the sequence and logic of condition application. Links this condition to the broader pricing determination framework.

attributes.name: sales_organization_code
attributes.description: SAP SD sales organization code that owns this pricing condition. Defines the organizational unit responsible for pricing governance and approval.

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: Geographic sales region or market code for which this pricing condition is valid. Enables region-specific pricing strategies to account for market conditions, competition, and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: sap_condition_table
attributes.description: Name of the SAP SD condition table (e.g., A001, A002) from which this condition record is sourced. Provides traceability to the source system configuration.

attributes.name: sap_konp_record_number
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD KONP table record number that stores the condition record master data. Enables direct linkage to the source system for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: sap_konv_counter
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD KONV table counter that tracks condition application instances in sales and billing documents. Used for transaction-level traceability.

attributes.name: scale_basis
attributes.description: Basis for scale-based pricing conditions. Defines the dimension (quantity, value, weight, volume) used to determine tiered pricing or volume-based discounts.

attributes.name: scale_quantity_from
attributes.description: Lower bound of the scale range for tiered pricing conditions. Defines the minimum quantity or value at which this condition rate applies.

attributes.name: scale_quantity_to
attributes.description: Upper bound of the scale range for tiered pricing conditions. Defines the maximum quantity or value at which this condition rate applies. Null indicates no upper limit.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this pricing condition record was extracted (e.g., SAP_SD, SFDC, DMS). Supports multi-system integration and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date from which this pricing condition becomes effective and can be applied to billing transactions. Part of the condition validity period.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date until which this pricing condition remains effective. Null indicates the condition is valid indefinitely. Part of the condition validity period.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this pricing condition record in the system. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: payment_term
products.description: Reference master for standard payment terms offered to billing accounts, defining due date calculation rules, early payment discount percentages, and penalty terms. Captures payment term code, description, net due days, discount percentage 1 and 2, discount days 1 and 2, penalty rate, penalty grace days, applicable account types (dealer/fleet/retail/corporate), and SAP FI payment term reference (T052). Used to standardize billing terms across all invoice types.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment term record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: Accounts often have a default payment term; linking provides a normalized reference.

attributes.name: applicable_account_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of billing account types to which this payment term applies (e.g., dealer, fleet, retail, corporate, OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer)).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this payment term was approved by finance or credit management. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether finance or credit manager approval is required before this payment term can be assigned to a customer account.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user ID of the finance or credit manager who approved this payment term for use. Null if no approval required or pending.

attributes.name: auto_dunning_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic dunning (collection reminder) process is enabled for invoices using this payment term.

attributes.name: baseline_date_rule
attributes.description: Rule defining the baseline date from which net due days and discount days are calculated (invoice date, delivery date, end of month, or custom).

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business unit or division that owns and manages this payment term (e.g., DEALER, FLEET, PARTS).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a credit check is required before this payment term can be assigned to a billing account.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for which this payment term is defined (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Null if applicable to all currencies.

attributes.name: discount_days_1
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which discount percentage 1 applies.

attributes.name: discount_days_2
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which discount percentage 2 applies (typically longer than discount days 1).

attributes.name: discount_percentage_1
attributes.description: First early payment discount percentage offered if payment is made within discount days 1 (e.g., 2.00 for 2%).

attributes.name: discount_percentage_2
attributes.description: Second early payment discount percentage offered if payment is made within discount days 2 (typically lower than discount 1).

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Default dunning level (escalation stage) for collection reminders associated with this payment term. Null if auto dunning is disabled.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this payment term is no longer valid for new assignments. Null if no end date is defined.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this payment term becomes valid and available for assignment to billing accounts.

attributes.name: fixed_day_of_month
attributes.description: If baseline date rule is custom, specifies a fixed day of the month for payment due date (e.g., 15 for the 15th of each month). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this payment term record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term record was last updated.

attributes.name: maximum_order_value
attributes.description: Maximum invoice or order value for which this payment term is applicable. Null if no maximum.

attributes.name: minimum_order_value
attributes.description: Minimum invoice or order value required for this payment term to be applicable. Null if no minimum.

attributes.name: net_due_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date by which full payment is due without penalty.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or internal comments about this payment term.

attributes.name: payment_method_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of allowed payment methods for this term (e.g., wire_transfer, check, ACH, credit_card). Empty if no restriction.

attributes.name: payment_term_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the payment term (e.g., NET30, 2/10N30, COD). Maps to SAP FI payment term key in table T052.

attributes.name: payment_term_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the payment term conditions, including discount and penalty clauses.

attributes.name: payment_term_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the payment term (e.g., Net 30 Days, 2% 10 Net 30, Cash on Delivery).

attributes.name: payment_term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment term: active (in use), inactive (not available for new assignments), deprecated (legacy term), or pending approval (awaiting finance approval).

attributes.name: penalty_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate late payment penalties: daily accrual, monthly accrual, flat fee, or none.

attributes.name: penalty_grace_days
attributes.description: Number of days after net due date before penalty charges begin to accrue.

attributes.name: penalty_rate
attributes.description: Late payment penalty rate applied after grace period expires, expressed as percentage per period (e.g., 1.5% per month).

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter geographic region code where this payment term is applicable (e.g., USA, EUR, JPN). Null if globally applicable.

attributes.name: sap_fi_payment_term_key
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP FI (Financial Accounting) Payment Term Key
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP FI payment term key in table T052 for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) integration and synchronization.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Number of active billing accounts or invoices currently using this payment term. Used for impact analysis before deprecation.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this payment term record.

products.name: tax_code
products.description: Reference master for tax codes applicable to automotive billing transactions across jurisdictions, capturing tax code identifier, tax type (VAT/GST/sales_tax/excise/luxury_tax/environmental_levy), jurisdiction (federal/state/local/EU/APAC), applicable transaction types, tax rate percentage, effective date, expiry date, tax authority reference, and SAP FI/SD tax code mapping. Supports multi-jurisdiction billing for domestic and export vehicle sales, parts, and services.

attributes.name: tax_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax code record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: Accounts may have a default tax code; linking normalizes tax code usage.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Tax codes are jurisdiction-specific by definition in automotive manufacturing. OEMs must map tax treatment (VAT, GST, sales tax) to regulatory territories for invoice compliance, cross-border vehicle

attributes.name: applicable_transaction_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of transaction types to which this tax code applies. Examples: vehicle_sale, parts_sale, service_labor, warranty_repair, fleet_lease, export_sale, dealer_invoice, retail_invoice. Supports multi-transaction applicability.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Document Type Configuration

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate the tax amount. Percentage for rate-based calculation, fixed_amount for flat fees, tiered for progressive rates based on value bands, formula_based for complex calculations (e.g., emissions-based environmental levies).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax code record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which tax amounts are calculated and reported (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, INR, CNY). Supports multi-currency billing operations.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this tax code and rate become active and applicable to transactions. Supports time-based tax rate changes and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP FI Tax Code Validity Period

attributes.name: exemption_certificate_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tax exemption certificate must be on file to apply this code for exempt transactions. True if certificate is mandatory, False otherwise. Supports compliance with exemption documentation requirements.
attributes.references: US Sales Tax Exemption Certificate Requirements, EU VAT Exemption Rules

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this tax code and rate cease to be valid. Nullable for indefinite validity. Supports sunset provisions and temporary tax measures.
attributes.references: SAP FI Tax Code Validity Period

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The GL account number to which tax amounts calculated using this code are posted in the financial ledger. Supports automated accounting entries and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Chart of Accounts, IFRS Financial Statement Presentation

attributes.name: is_deductible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax is deductible as a business expense for income tax purposes. Relevant for excise duties and certain non-recoverable taxes.
attributes.references: OECD Model Tax Convention, Local GAAP

attributes.name: is_recoverable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax paid under this code can be recovered or reclaimed from the tax authority (e.g., input VAT). True for recoverable taxes, False for non-recoverable taxes.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_level
attributes.description: The governmental or regional level at which this tax is levied. Federal for national taxes, state for US state or equivalent provincial taxes, local for city/county taxes, EU for European Union-wide directives, APAC for Asia-Pacific regional harmonized taxes, multi_jurisdiction for taxes spanning multiple levels.
attributes.references: UNECE Vehicle Regulations, OECD Tax Policy Framework

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this tax code record. Supports change management and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax code record was most recently updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special instructions, or clarifications regarding the application of this tax code. May include references to specific regulations, exemptions, or business rules.

attributes.name: reporting_code
attributes.description: The code or box number used when reporting this tax on statutory returns (e.g., VAT return box 1, GST return line 3A). Supports automated regulatory reporting and compliance.
attributes.references: Jurisdiction-specific tax return forms and instructions

attributes.name: reverse_charge_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reverse charge mechanism applies, where the customer rather than the supplier accounts for VAT. Common in B2B cross-border EU transactions and certain domestic supplies.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive Article 196, OECD International VAT/GST Guidelines

attributes.name: rounding_precision
attributes.description: The number of decimal places to which tax amounts are rounded (e.g., 2 for cents/pence, 0 for whole currency units). Supports multi-currency precision requirements.

attributes.name: rounding_rule
attributes.description: The rounding method applied to calculated tax amounts. Round_up for ceiling, round_down for floor, round_nearest for standard rounding, no_rounding for exact amounts. Ensures compliance with jurisdiction-specific rounding regulations.

attributes.name: sap_fi_tax_code
attributes.description: The corresponding tax code identifier in SAP FI module (table T007A, field MWSKZ). Typically 1-2 character alphanumeric. Enables integration and reconciliation between lakehouse and SAP ERP.
attributes.references: SAP FI Tax Code Master Data (T007A)

attributes.name: sap_sd_tax_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Tax Code
attributes.description: The corresponding tax code identifier in SAP SD module used in sales orders and billing documents. May differ from FI code in some implementations. Supports sales-specific tax determination.

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the governmental or regulatory body responsible for administering this tax. Examples: Internal Revenue Service (IRS), HM Revenue & Customs (HMRC), Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN), California Department of Tax and Fee Administration.

attributes.name: tax_authority_reference
attributes.description: The official reference number, code, or identifier assigned by the tax authority for this tax type or rate. Used for regulatory reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: tax_basis
attributes.description: The base amount on which the tax rate is applied. Net_amount for taxes on pre-tax subtotal, gross_amount for taxes on total including other taxes (cascading), MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price) for luxury taxes, invoice_value for dealer invoices, customs_value for import duties.
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, WTO Customs Valuation Agreement

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: The accounting treatment category for this tax. Input_tax for recoverable VAT on purchases, output_tax for VAT charged on sales, withholding_tax for taxes deducted at source, reverse_charge for customer-remitted VAT, exempt for tax-exempt transactions, zero_rated for 0% taxable supplies.

attributes.name: tax_code_code
attributes.description: The alphanumeric tax code identifier used in billing and invoicing systems. Maps to SAP FI/SD tax code field (MWSKZ). Examples: VAT_STD, GST_18, SALES_TX_CA, EXCISE_LUX.

attributes.name: tax_code_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the tax code for display and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: tax_code_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax code. Active for codes in use, inactive for retired codes, pending for codes awaiting regulatory approval, superseded for codes replaced by newer versions.

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The tax rate as a percentage (e.g., 19.0000 for 19% VAT, 5.5000 for 5.5% GST). Precision to four decimal places supports fine-grained rates. Used to calculate tax amount from taxable base.
attributes.references: OECD Tax Database, SAP FI Tax Rate Configuration

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: The category of tax represented by this code. VAT (Value Added Tax) for EU and similar jurisdictions, GST (Goods and Services Tax) for India/Australia/Canada, sales_tax for US state-level, excise for fuel/alcohol/tobacco duties, luxury_tax for high-value vehicles, environmental_levy for emissions-based charges.
attributes.references: OECD International VAT/GST Guidelines, US Sales Tax regulations

attributes.name: withholding_tax_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether withholding tax provisions apply to transactions using this code. Relevant for cross-border payments and certain domestic transactions where tax is deducted at source.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this tax code record. Supports accountability and audit trail.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.powertrain_spec. Business justification: OEM rebate programs (EV incentives, hybrid purchase rebates) are scoped to specific powertrain configurations. Replacing the free-text powertrain_scope with a structured FK to powertrain_spec enables

attributes.name: powertrain_variant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.powertrain_variant. Business justification: EV and hybrid incentive rebate agreements in automotive are scoped to specific powertrain variants (e.g., BEV-only rebates, PHEV incentives). The existing powertrain_scope is denormalized text; a prop

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_requirement. Business justification: Rebate programs are tied to specific regulatory incentives; linking enables tracking of compliance‑driven rebates.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sku_master. Business justification: Rebate agreements often apply to specific parts/materials SKUs (e.g., promotional parts rebates, volume discounts on specific components). Required for parts rebate program management and dealer incen

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Rebate agreements are defined per vehicle program; linking to vehicle_program allows accurate accruals, compliance reporting, and program‑specific financial analysis.

attributes.name: accrual_method
attributes.description: Method by which rebate amounts are calculated and accrued: periodic (monthly/quarterly calculation), milestone (triggered when target is reached), transaction_based (accrued per invoice).

attributes.name: achieved_volume
attributes.description: Actual number of vehicle units sold or delivered under this agreement as of the last accrual calculation. Updated periodically based on billing transactions.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the rebate agreement, typically generated by SAP SD rebate management (BO01/BO02) or dealer management system.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rebate agreement: draft (under negotiation), active (in force), suspended (temporarily paused), expired (validity period ended), terminated (cancelled before expiry), settled (final payment completed).

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate agreement defining the incentive structure: volume_rebate (quantity-based), loyalty_bonus (retention incentive), conquest_bonus (new customer acquisition), fleet_incentive (commercial fleet programs), model_mix_bonus (product mix targets), early_payment_discount (payment terms incentive).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate agreement was approved by authorized personnel. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the rebate agreement: pending_approval (awaiting management sign-off), approved (authorized for execution), rejected (not approved).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user ID of the manager or executive who approved the rebate agreement. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: beneficiary_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rebate recipient: dealer (franchise dealership), fleet_customer (commercial fleet operator), distributor (regional distributor), broker (third-party intermediary).

attributes.name: contract_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or file path to the signed legal contract or agreement document supporting this rebate arrangement. Used for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rebate agreement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: dealer_tier
attributes.description: Performance tier classification of the dealer beneficiary, used to determine rebate eligibility and rate structure. Higher tiers may receive enhanced rebate terms.

attributes.name: dispute_description
attributes.description: Description of the dispute or disagreement related to the rebate agreement terms, calculation, or settlement. Null if no dispute exists.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rebate agreement or its settlement is currently under dispute. True if disputed, False otherwise. Used to flag agreements requiring resolution.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate agreement expires and no further transactions accrue rebates. Nullable for open-ended agreements subject to annual renewal.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate agreement becomes active and eligible transactions begin accruing rebates. Aligns with fiscal year (FY) or model year (MY) boundaries.

attributes.name: is_retroactive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rebate agreement applies retroactively to transactions that occurred before the agreement effective start date. True if retroactive, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_accrual_calculation_date
attributes.description: Date when the rebate accrual amounts were last recalculated based on eligible transactions. Used to track data freshness and trigger next calculation cycle.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rebate agreement record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_settlement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent rebate settlement payment or credit memo issuance. Null if no settlements have occurred.

attributes.name: next_settlement_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next rebate settlement payment or credit memo generation. Null if agreement is settled or terminated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special terms, or clarifications related to the rebate agreement. Used for operational context and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining rebate amount accrued but not yet settled. Calculated as total_accrued_amount minus total_settled_amount.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which rebate is settled: credit_memo (issued against future purchases), direct_payment (bank transfer or check), offset_against_invoice (deducted from current receivables).

attributes.name: rebate_amount_per_unit
attributes.description: Fixed rebate amount paid per vehicle unit sold. Used for flat-rate rebate structures. Null if percentage-based rebate is used.

attributes.name: rebate_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage rate applied to eligible transaction amounts to calculate rebate accrual. Used for percentage-based rebate structures. Null if fixed amount rebate is used.

attributes.name: sales_region
attributes.description: Geographic sales region or territory to which this rebate agreement applies. Used for regional incentive programs and performance tracking.

attributes.name: sap_rebate_agreement_number
attributes.description: SAP SD rebate agreement reference number from transaction codes BO01 (create) or BO02 (change). Used for system integration and traceability.

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which accrued rebates are paid out to the beneficiary: monthly, quarterly, semi_annual, annual, or upon_completion (at agreement end).

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of rebate settlement: not_started (no payments made), in_progress (settlement cycle active), partially_settled (some payments made), fully_settled (all accruals paid), disputed (settlement under review).

attributes.name: target_volume
attributes.description: Target number of vehicle units that must be sold or delivered to qualify for the rebate. Null for non-volume-based agreements.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the rebate agreement was terminated early, if applicable. Null for agreements that expired naturally or are still active.

attributes.name: total_accrued_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative rebate amount accrued under this agreement as of the last calculation date. Represents the liability owed to the beneficiary.

attributes.name: total_settled_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative rebate amount paid out to the beneficiary through credit memos or direct payments. Used to track settlement progress.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `automotive_ecm`.`_metrics`.`aftersales_repair_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core aftersales repair order KPIs tracking revenue, labor efficiency, warranty mix, and customer satisfaction across service operations"
  source: "`automotive_ecm`.`aftersales`.`aftersales_repair_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "repair_order_status"
      expr: aftersales_repair_order_status
      comment: "Current status of the repair order (open, in-progress, completed, closed)"
    - name: "service_type"
      expr: service_type
      comment: "Type of service performed (maintenance, repair, recall, warranty, diagnostic)"
    - name: "warranty_flag"
      expr: warranty_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether the repair order is covered under warranty"
    - name: "service_priority"
      expr: service_priority

    - name: "payment_status"
      expr: payment_status
      comment: "Payment status of the repair order (pending, paid, partial, refunded)"
    - name: "service_center_region"
      expr: service_center_region
      comment: "Geographic region of the service center performing the repair"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency code for financial amounts"
    - name: "is_estimate"
      expr: is_estimate

    - name: "customer_feedback_score"
      expr: customer_feedback_score
      comment: "Customer satisfaction score for the service experience"
    - name: "service_year"
      expr: YEAR(created_timestamp)
      comment: "Year the repair order was created"
    - name: "service_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', created_timestamp)
      comment: "Month the repair order was created"
    - name: "service_quarter"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', created_timestamp)
      comment: "Quarter the repair order was created"
  measures:
    - name: "total_repair_orders"

    - name: "total_revenue"
